By building a trusted computing environment at the mobile terminal, the proposed scheme combines verifying validity of software with access control, and checks the validity and the integrity of software in the security service provider. Under our scheme, the security ability supplied to the terminals and the whole network is much better.

articleTitle: Successive Interference Cancellation for Distributed Space-Time Coding in Cooperative Cellular Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A signal detection technique using successive interference cancellation (SIC) for uplink cooperative cellular systems is proposed in this paper, to suppress the interference caused by the cooperative transmission of two mobile users transmitting both their own information and the cooperative partner's information using distributed space-time coding (DSTC). Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms the existing joint DSTC and equalization scheme in terms of system performance with time division multiple access.

articleTitle: Opportunistic Relaying with Limit Feedback in Two-Way Relaying over OFDM with Subcarrier Mapping
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Two-way relaying is an efficient way to improve the network capacity significantly. Subcarrier mapping (SCM) has been shown to evidently improve the average end-to-end capacity in OFDM relay networks. However perfect channel knowledge is required, which leads to large feedback amount of channel state information (CSI). In this paper, the multi-relay scenario of two-way relaying over OFDM based on sub-carrier mapping is investigated. An opportunistic relaying scheme with limit feedback CSI is proposed. The transmission scheme, which is based on instantaneous channel quality, is selected to offer maximum the system capacity. The simulations show that the proposed approach can achieve almost asymptotically performance as full CSI feedback scheme with large number of sub-carriers.

articleTitle: A Gateway Discovery Method for MANET Accessing Internet Based on Overhead Control
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Looking for usable gateway is a process, which brings the biggest overhead, in MANET accessing Internet. For controlling the routing overhead effectively, a gateway discovery method for MANET accessing Internet based on overhead control, which is according to the similar between ant searching path and mobile node searching gateway, is proposed in this paper. By simulating the pheromone's update process in ant colony algorithm, this method uses information carried in route reply packet to update gateway pheromone. According to the pheromone density on the link, link bandwidth and delay, the node computes transmission probability and transmits the route request packet. This method is simulated by NS2.29. The test result indicates that though it increases average delay appreciably, it reduces normalized routing overhead effectively and increases packet delivery radio. The validity of the method is validated.

articleTitle: Closed-Form Error Analysis of Decode-and-Forward Relaying over Non-Identical Nakagami-m Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: this paper analyzes the performance of fixed decode-and-forward (FDF) relaying and selection decode-and-forward (SDF) relaying network over non-identical Nakagami-m fading channels. The colsed-form outage probabilities and average symbol error probabilities (ASEPs) are derived. Additionally, we provide closed-form outage probability in multiuser scenarios with maximum SNR schedule. These proposed theoretical results are verified by computer simulations.

articleTitle: A Multi-Synchronous Reference Algorithm of Symbol Rate Estimation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In non-cooperative communication system, symbol rate is a crucial part of parameter estimation. The symbol rate estimation is deeply researched by the use of Continuous Wavelet transform (CWT). And a new multi-synchronous reference(MSR)approach is proposed to extract precise symbol rate of M-ary Phase Shift Keying (MPSK) signal. The value of MSR algorithm is focused on lower signal-to-noise rate (SNR) scenarios. Simulation shows that both the performance of anti-noise and the accuracy are much higher than traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis on Propagation Characteristics of Highway Communication Using Hybrid FDTD and Ray-Tracing Method
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The propagation characteristic of highway communication is investigated by using FDTD/ray-tracing method numerically. To achieve the accurate radiation characteristics, much tinier mesh size of FDTD and ray-tracing method are employed. Take the complicated environment in the inter-city highway into consideration, tunnel with leaky coaxial cable, antenna and sensors are included to realize the propagation characteristic of the system. The experimental and numerical results show that the radiation field of the mobile inter-city highway communication system can be obtained efficiently and exactly.

articleTitle: Facilitating Current Terminals Accessing to Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: More users are overcrowding into the partial band, which leads to relative scarcity of the spectrum. In the last decade, cognitive radio is widely regarded as promising technology, which promotes secondary users dynamically accessing to network in the spectrum overlay or underlay way. In the previous blueprint, individual terminals must first cognize spectrum holes, and then utilize the available band. However, there are many challenges for personal terminals with limited software and hardware to achieve the sensing task. We propose the strategy transferring spectrum sensing role of cognitive user to the centralized entity, minimizing terminal cost. We introduce spectrum-cognizing server (SCS) to determine the vacant spectrum. The server can further allocate unutilized spectrum to secondary users in the overlay way and control their transmission power in underlay mode. We argue that network with central SCS provides transparent spectrum service to end-users who can focus on data transmission. Consequently, subscribers who satisfy the wide band operation can seamlessly work in cognitive radio networks. We compare SCS, cooperative sensing and other database-enabled schemes in terms of terminal cost, sensing interference, solution to the hidden node problem and so on, thereby find that SCS has more advantages.

articleTitle: A Novel Service-Oriented Network Structure in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since one single node in a wireless sensor network (WSN) is quite power-limited, many of existing researches focus on abating the redundancy of transmission to achieve the goal of energy saving. However, they are mostly highly dependent on physical networks and routing, which will result in the excessive rawness of data, the great imbalance of energy consumption among nodes and the poor scalability of the network. To solve these problems, in this paper, with a number of brokers placed in the sensing domain, a service-oriented network structure is established by applying a networking algorithm based on routing distance. This network is distributed and self-organized, in which services are regarded as the units of node data and are forwarded within the network through the publish/subscribe communication model. Simulation results show that the network can efficiently locally process and transmit the services, manifesting a large advantage in energy saving and balance so as to extend the lifetime and applicability of the network.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on MIMO Antenna Configuration of High-Speed Railroad System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The performances of various antenna configurations are compared from a capacity point of view for the high-speed railway MIMO system. The standard IMT-Advanced (IMT-A) channel model proposed by International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is adopted in the capacity analysis. The results show that the MIMO capacity increases with the element number and spacing of the antenna array. It is also illustrated that the polarized antenna can be utilized for capacity enhancement. Moreover, the impact of array orientation is investigated based on the special layout of the railway communication scenario. According to the simulation results, some suggestions on the MIMO configurations are given for the improvement of the next generation railway communication system.

articleTitle: An Improved Dynamic Coalition Generation Based on Ant Colony Algorithm for Target Detection in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cooperation among sensor nodes is a significant issue in large-scale, complicated Wireless Sensor Networks(WSN). Target tracking is a canonical application of WSN. The dynamic coalition mechanism in WSN for target detection is an important method to improve the tracking quality which saves much energy. An energy efficient coalition formation algorithm is needed because the energy resource of WSN is restricted. In this paper, we propose a WSN dynamic coalition formation based on Ant Colony algorithm (DCF_AC). The sink node of every group is the group head, which knows the global coordinate of its own and inclines to wake sensor nodes around the target with high residual energy to form coalition periodically. The algorithm can balance the energy consumption among sensor nodes, so as to extend the network lifetime for more tasks. The results of experiments concludes the validity of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel FDE-NP Scheme of SC-FDE System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new kind of equalization scheme of SC-FDE system is proposed in this paper, which uses the distribution differences of residual inter-symbol interference between conventional FDE-NP decision feedback equalization and reversed FDE-NP decision feedback equalization to reduce the residual ISI caused by multipath channel. The feedback coefficients of reversed FDE-NP equalizer are conjugate with that of the conventional FDE-NP equalizer. The simulation results show that this method can improve the detection performance of SC-FDE system in multipath channel.

articleTitle: Exploration of IPv6 Network Construction on Campus
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Lack of IP address space has become the bottleneck of the Internet development. The existing Internet protocol IPv4 cannot meet the development needs. As a next generation network protocol, IPv6 new features for the next generation of Internet applications and development provide a broad prospect and support. IPv6 network deployment is the current hot spot, network construction in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing and other cities has deployed IPv6 MAN. In this paper, North China Electric Power University IPv6 campus network construction as an example, to explore the construction of the IPv6 campus network.

articleTitle: A Data Selective Segment Proportionate Affine Projection Algorithm for Echo Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The segment proportionate normalized least mean-square algorithm (SPNLMS) has been proposed with the objective of improving the adaptation convergence rate when modeling high-order sparse impulse response systems as compared to their conventional counterparts.. When the excitation signal is colored, especially the speech, the convergence performance of SPNLMS algorithm demonstrates slow convergence speed. The segment proportionate affine projection (SPAP) algorithm is an useful adaptive filter to improve the convergence speed of PNLMS-type filter by updating the weight vector based on several previous input vectors, Unfortunately, the SPAP algorithm obtains a faster convergence of the SPNLMS comes at the expense of an increase in the computational complexity linked to the amount of reuses employed. For this reason, the idea of proportionate adaptation combined with the framework of set-membership filtering in an attempt to reduce computational complexity of algorithm is presented. The proposed algorithm allows the reduction of the frequency of updates of the filter coefficients, where the filter coefficients are updated such that the output estimation error is upper bounded by a pre-determined threshold. Simulations show that its overall complexity is lower compared to fully updated SPAP and its performance is close to that of the SPAP algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy Detection Scheme to Improve Detection Sensitivity in Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the relationship of energy detection performance and detection sensitivity with average noise power fluctuation in short time is investigated firstly. Detection sensitivity dropped quickly with average noise power fluctuation increasing and worse in low signal-to-noise ratio. To the characteristic, a novel energy detection algorithm to improve detection sensitivity and detection performance is presented, that is, the scheme can be visualized as a combination of matched filter detector and energy detector. Results show that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the detection sensitivity, low signal-to-noise ratio environment equally applicable.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 802.11-Based MAC Protocol in Multi-Relay Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we design and analyze a new 802.11- based cooperative MAC protocol. Since the wireless fading interval sometimes is comparable to the time of multiple-frame transmission, the traditional retransmission schemes may not be optimal. We consider designing a multi- relay system where neighbor nodes can assist the retransmission in order to achieve transmission diversity and combat channel fading. Since the cooperative capacity varies from relay to relay, the key point lies in how to assign different priorities to relays. This paper proposes a priority-based contention mechanism in cooperation, and tries to derive the optimal cooperation contention window size to maximize the network throughput. We present the results both from simulation and from theoretical analysis, which jointly verify the excellent performance of our new protocol.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Error Concealment Technology on Wireless Video Communication
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless video communication, error concealment is a key question because of high error bit. This paper focus simulation error concealment based on the error hiding technologies based on content, and analyze the performance of various technologies, and finally given in the actual communication system to choose a suitable error concealment technology.

articleTitle: Near-Log-MAP Decoding for Turbo Product Codes
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Turbo product codes (TPCs) have been studied since 1994. However, existing decoding algorithms for TPCs are generally based on the algorithm presented by Pyndiah [1], which adopts the idea of MAX-Log-MAP algorithm and neglects the channel side information (CSI). In this paper, we present and investigate the "M-Log-MAP" decoding algorithm that considers multiple codewords in calculating the extrinsic information. It is shown that the algorithm can improve the decoding performance to the near-Log-MAP decoding with a small M (≈ 4). The complexity of the decoding algorithm is also analyzed.

articleTitle: The Application of Multiple Care-of Addresses Registration to Network Mobility Basic Support Protocol
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Multiple Care-of Addresses Registration mechanism was designed for a single Mobile IPv6 node, but when this mechanism is used on nested Network Mobility, the Mobile Routers do not know how many paths are available and how to control the path of a packet, and the Mobile Router cannot get the upper layer Mobile Network's link failure information to adjust the routing. The "Path ID" mechanism is designed to identify a path, and based on this mechanism, the Home Registration procedure is modified to detect all the available paths, the routing of common data packets is modified to control the path for a packet, and the Router Advertisement message is modified to inform the lower layer Mobile Networks about the upper layer link failure.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Soft Information Cooperation in Bi-Directional Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose the soft information cooperation scheme in the bi-directional wireless relay networks.We first compute the Log-Likelihood ratio (LLR), referred to as the soft information of relay received signal in Rayleigh fading channel, and then propose an efficient LLR-based network coding scheme. Moreover, for computational simplicity, we optimize the soft information cooperation by the defined self soft information at terminals. In addition, we analyze the system performance in terms of generalized signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR), which is shown to be an efficient metric to reveal the BER performance, for one-relay and multi-relay cases. The simulation results show that the soft information cooperation scheme outperforms the traditional amplify-and-forward (AF), decode-and-forward (DF) and compress-and- forward (CF) protocols in terms of GSNR and bit- error rate (BER) in the low-SNR regime.

articleTitle: Design and FPGA Verification of Dual-Speed Adaptive Ethernet Controller
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The embedded Ethernet is widely applied, and its research is very important. In this paper, the embedded Ethernet controller is designed. The Ethernet MAC sublayer protocol and the architecture of Ethernet data frame are briefly introduced. The 10/100Mbps adaptive Ethernet controller is designed with Verilog-HDL, which includes the WISHBONE bus interface, Tx/Rx module, flow control module, etc. The testing vectors are constructed and the whole design is simulated in ModelSim PLUS 6.4SE tools and successfully verified by ALTERA FPGA. The result of logic simulation and FPGA physical verification of board level indicate that the related function of 10/100Mbps adaptive Ethernet controller is realized.

articleTitle: Research of Mobile Map Service for Smart Phone Based on Mobile SVG
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a map service prototype which is J2ME-supported and for smart phone has been designed and implemented based on Mobile SVG technology. The Mobile SVG is suitable for map service. It is a text format and can be organized and transformed easily. The prototype consists of two parts. One is the client application, the other one is the Server application. The protocol between client and server is HTTP. The prototype's topological architecture and function architecture are described particularly. In addition, transforming between map data and Mobile SVG, graphics layer's organization and overlapping strategies and enhancing efficiency data transmission are discussed mainly. The prototype is tested based on map data of Beijing in Nokia E71 and experimental result shows that is valuable in future application and popularization.

articleTitle: The Constant Norm Algorithm Based on the Soft Decision Feedback Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Decision Feedback Equalizer is a common equalizer in the blind equalization. It's a nonlinear equalizer which is always used with the Constant Modulus Algorithm. The Constant Norm Algorithm can be used in it to enhance the equalization performance. The introduce of soft decision will improve it future more. The computer simulation results would verify its significance.

articleTitle: Location Aided Multi-Constrained Ant Colony QoS Routing Algorithm for Tactical MANETs
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve the stability and efficiency of routes, and satisfy the QoS requirements simultaneously, a novel multiple constrained ACO based QoS routing algorithm suitable for tactical MANETs (MC-AQRA) is proposed. MC-AQRA uses location information to estimate the link's lifetime, and integrates link lifetime and node congestion into conventional QoS requirements such as bandwidth and delay, therefore the routes established by MC-AQRA not only satisfy the conventional QoS requirements, but also have the highest stability and the least congestion. Simulation results show that MC-AQRA outperforms AODV and AntHocNet in terms of end-to-end delay, packet delivery ratio and routing overhead.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of AODV over DSR on Demand Routing Protocols - Aspect of Packet Salvaging in AODV
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nodes in mobile ad hoc networks communicate with one another via packet radios on wireless multihop links. Because of node mobility and power limitations, the network topology changes frequently. Routing protocols therefore play an important role in mobile multihop network communications. This network is intended for situations when it is not economically practical or physically possible to deploy the necessary infrastructure, for example in temporary or remote locations such as rescue operations or military applications [1]. A recent trend in ad hoc network routing is the reactive on-demand philosophy where routes are established only when required. Most of the protocols in this category, however, use single route and do not utilize multiple alternate paths. In this paper, I propose a scheme to improve existing on-demand routing protocols by creating a mesh and providing multiple alternate routes. My algorithm establishes the mesh and multipaths without transmitting any extra control message. I apply my scheme to the Ad-hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) protocol and evaluate the performance improvements by simulation.

articleTitle: Research of a System for Monitoring Body Posture Based on Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Trend of accelerated aging society increases need of care for the aged at home. To fit this need, we designed the continuous body posture monitoring system based on wireless sensor networks. The hardware platform is made up of anchor nodes, the central control node and wireless sensor nodes which include the three axis low-g accelerometer MMA7260, 2-axis magnetic sensor HMC5883L and CC2431 System-on-Chip (SoC). This system positions human indoor through the fingerprint identification algorithms, recognizes posture by establishing model of posture. To distinguish abnormal posture from daily activities through the posture, position and acceleration vector threshold. The result show that the system can successfully distinguish between normal posture and abnormal posture in real-time.

articleTitle: Dijkstra's Algorithm Model over MPLS / GMPLS
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: the increased use of virtual connections in packet switched networks, in particular over the Internet, using MPLS and GMPLS evolution has produced a significant amount of studies on traffic engineering protocols, especially with regard to the different ways to provide quality of service over connections. This article presents a model to characterize the reliability of these types of networks, in computing restricted route domain. With these elements, an application is proposed, to establish virtual connections with likely default reliability on MPLS / GMPLS networks.

articleTitle: A Joint Soft Sparse Encoding Scheme for Relay System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we study a joint soft sparse encoding scheme for the three-node relay system. The relayed soft information is expressed basing on the Log- Likelihood-Ratios (LLRs) of the received signals at the relay. We investigate this coding method by using a regular LDPC code at the source and a sparse generator matrix at the relay. We also deliberately design the structure of the joint code by Gaussian approximation. Simulation results demonstrate that the system which uses the proposed coding scheme can obtain a considerable gain over the traditional hard encoding scheme.

articleTitle: A Solution for Chinese Efficient Channelization in IEEE 802.11ac Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently, the framework for IEEE 802.11ac will include support for an efficient channelization in China's spectrum, which can improve spectrum utilization. But it also entails some new unresolved problems. The first question we should resolve is the compatibility between 802.11a/n and 802.11ac.This paper will present a scheme aiming for the compatibility. The proposal will consider all channels as partially overlapping channels, and assign them based on classical graph coloring. On the premise of high throughput, the usage of partially overlapping channels can flexibly solve the compatibility.

articleTitle: A Simplified Full-Duplex Wavelength Interleaved DWDM Hybrid Access Radio-Over-Fiber System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We demonstrate a simplified full-duplex wavelength interleaved (WI)-DWDM hybrid access radio-over-fiber (ROF) system for providing 2 GB/s wired and 1 GB/s wireless downlink and 1 GB/s uplink data data simultaneously. In this scheme, we use only one arrayed waveguide grating device to realize both the demultiplexing and multiplexing functions. Because of using only the subcarriers of the single channel to carry both the wired and wireless data, we do not need extra optical components such as interleaver to separate them at the base stations. The experimental results demonstrate that this scheme is feasible and has good transmission performance for the future WI-DWDM hybrid access ROF system.

articleTitle: A Topology Control Algorithm for Mobile Nodes Used in Coal Face
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the characteristics of the coal face in coal mine, a novel topology control algorithms LHD (limited highest degree) for mobile nodes is proposed in this paper. And the cluster maintenance for mobility is detailed also. The theory analysis and simulation results show that LHD can keep more stability of cluster structure and reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Analysis and Discussion of Mobile Group Communication for Passenger Dedicated Lines
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose a group location management scheme used for passenger dedicated lines, in which mobile users with same moving trend are combined as a group. In the scheme, each group is identified by a group ID Gi, and implements unified location management process though a group proxy deployed on the train. Thus in the network side, instead of modifying each user's location information separately, the location update process can be achieved by modifying the location information of the group in corresponding entities. By implementing of this scheme, less spectrum resource will be used, and it is effective in preventing signaling channel congestion. Simulation results show that, compared with traditional scheme, when the number of group members exceeds a threshold, with the group member increasing, the overhead generated from location management reducing significantly. And reasonable network deployment will make network more efficient.

articleTitle: Synthesizing CDR Technology for MMS in Packet Switching Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper shows a general view of the Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) in the packet switching network (PSN), such as the technology features, the service flows and the major signaling messages. The Calling Detail Record (CDR) synthesis theory of MMS in PSN is studied in detail. This paper also discusses multi-protocol and multi-interface association technology in signaling monitoring process of MMS. Finally, the research results are tested based on the synthesis theory.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on R&D Choices
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research and development activity is a vital strategy for enterprises in market competition. Researches concerning R&D are mainly focusing on enterprises' cooperative R&D contemporarily, which lacks of systematic study on enterprises' R&D strategies. This article is based on related researches, using Duopoly Market Model to analyze the economic mechanism of enterprises' three different choices on R&D. The choices are, (1) Not conducting R&D and; (2) Conducting R&D and; (3) Making R&D cooperatively.

articleTitle: The Transmission Capacity of UWB WSN Based on Non-Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The model of UWB WSN(wireless sensor networks) was proposed firstly, by UWB and non-coherent detection technology, a non-coherent detection receiver for UWB WSN was designed and the transmission capacity was studied. We found it will benefit to improve the transmission capacity of the UWB wireless sensor network if employing the non-coherent detection technology.

articleTitle: The Research and Design of Remote Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most devices in power plant work in hostile environment, such as high temperature, humidity and danger. Our goal is to monitor and manage the battery protection system by the Industrial Ethernet. Eventually, we expect to design out the on-line battery architecture with remote communication function and the dynamic human-machine interface to ensure the protection system can work at the crucial moment.

articleTitle: Multiple Keywords Model on Sponsored Search Auction
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose the model of multiple keywords auction in the foundation of the generalized second price (GSP) auction and analyse its equilibria.

articleTitle: Waveguide Slot Antenna Design and Optimizing That Uses a Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Antennas are key components of wireless communication systems and radar systems. Rectangular waveguide slot antennas are widely applied in ground radar equipments, airborne radars and satellite and space communications. But their design and optimizing are rather complex. Here a neural network is introduced to optimize the length of the slots in a antenna. The result shows that after training, the neural network can predict the Y parameter well and make the process of optimizing easier.

articleTitle: MMSE Estimation of Frequency Offset for OFDM
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a MMSE (Minimum Mean Square Error) estimation of frequency offset for OFDM is proposed, utilizing the ICI (Inter Carrier Interference). Essentially, the ICI arises from the unorthogonality between subcarriers caused by frequency offset, which gives the chance to estimate frequency offset using ICI. To obtain the MMSE estimation of frequency offset, a linear approximation of ICI is derived. Additionally, theoretical analysis of the proposed MMSE estimator is also given. Usually, the classical estimation theory ignores the prior distribution information of parameter that is to be estimated, while in the proposed MMSE estimation, the variance of frequency offset is utilized and the variance of frequency offset can be easily obtained through the ppm (par per million) value of oscillator.

articleTitle: Research on OFDM-ROF System at Millimeter-Wave Band Employing Optical External Modulator Generation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A 40GHz Radio-over-Fiber system is proposed to transmit 2.5Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM wireless signals with only 20GHz RF source. Simulation results show that a reliable EVM value is obtained after 40km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Online Reprogramming Method of Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In WSN (wireless sensor network), due to the changes of environment and application demands, we need to configure and reprogram the node online. This paper presents a cluster based hierarchical structure program image dispatching method, each cluster using different wireless channel, to avoid the message collision effectively. In the meantime, a paging mechanism-based retransmission is introduced, which uses the bit vector to trace the page lost, resulting in the little consuming of the RAM maintaining all the state of the pages. Finally we evaluate this method from the transmitting reliability, storage occupies and energy consumption and so on. The results show that this method can reprogram the node reliably in the complex situations

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of EAP_AKA for IEEE Standard 802.16e
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In IEEE Standard 802.16e, there are two privacy key management editions PKMv1 and PKMv2. PKMv2 as a supplement is used to improve the IEEE standard 802.16e security, in which EAP as an optional authentication protocol besides RSA is involved in several authentication modes. However how to use EAP methods in different authentication mode has not been detailed. In this paper, common EAP methods will be compared according to authentication requirement in IEEE standard 802.16e. Then the EAP_AKA as selected method for EAP-EAP authentication mode will be detailed. The security and authentication cost also will be compared with the existed improved methods.

articleTitle: Performance Study on Convolutional Coded MSK Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This thesis investigates the performance of serially concatenated convolutional coded minimum shift keying (MSK) system when the receiver employs iterative decoding and demodulation. Since MSK system can be decomposed into a continuous-phase decoder (CPE) and memoryless mapper (MM), it can be used as an inner code combined with interleaved convolutional codes. Simulation results show that the interleaver should be chosen carefully, and with pseudorandom interleaver, joint iterations between the MSK demodulator and the convlutional decoder can improve the performance remarkably. However, with more powerful outer convoltional codes, the system does not perform better.

articleTitle: Protocol Study of ZigBee Serial Transparent Transmission with Voltage Detection Function
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to reduce the difficulty of applying ZigBee technology to wireless sensor network system, this paper introduces a serial transparent transmission system based on ZigBee protocol, and gives a method of detecting nodes voltage. Using this method can flexibly grasp the electrical quantities of terminal node power supply equipment in network. This system's core hardware is Chipcon's CC2430, and TI's Zstack-1.4.3-1.2.1 implements the software design. The application of the system can easily embed the ZigBee protocol into wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Image Indexing Using Shape Feature
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the analysis of the traditional image retrieval in DCT compressed domain, a novel extraction algorithm is proposed in this paper. The DCT block is firstly classified into different edge type by exploiting five AC coefficients. Then, the edge spatial distribution map is constructed. According to the statistical feature of the map, the edge spatial distribution feature (ESDF) is presented. Meantime, the effect of the energy of DCT blocks on retrieval were considered, a weight is introduced into ESDF. The experiment results show that the new method has a good performance both in retrieval efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Modified MRC Detection Scheme with Spatially Coloured Noise
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A modified maximal ratio combining (MRC) detection scheme is provided in single-input multiple-output (SIMO) systems considering the spatially coloured noise at the receiver. The noise in different branches is spatially coloured in practical systems since each path uses an independent radio frequency chain. Furthermore, independent automatic gain control (AGC) for each branch is another factor that causes the spatially coloured noise. The modified MRC detection scheme taking spatially coloured noise in consideration is derived from theory and its validity is proved by the simulation results.

articleTitle: The Improvement of LaserMeter Background Light Interference
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper describes the composition and working principle of lasermeter system , and analyze the reasons for Measurements Become larger when the background Luminance Increasing, which not reach the reasons ranging accuracy.Through the Calculation of optical power and Description of APD characteristics ,it proposued an optical and electronic methods of APD receiver circuit , reduce the I-V Conversion resistor and increase in amplifier compensation unit to achieve under normal lighting conditions ranging accuracy to meet the requirements.

articleTitle: SER Performance Analysis for Jointing Network Coding and Space Time Codes in DF Relay System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new joint coding scheme that combine the network coding and the conditional distributed space-time codes was proposed in decode-and-forward (DF) wireless relay network. Symbol-error-rate (SER) performance of proposed scheme was analyzed. Based on studying the SER of the traditional distributed space time in three relays system, the SER closed-form and upper-bounds expression of scheme were derived. In our systems, three relays were considered. Two relays were operated as the space time codes, and one relay was used as the simple network coding. The theoretical analysis proved that proposed joint coding scheme had better performance of SER than traditional space time codes in DF relay system. The numerical results shown that our scheme had the lower SER compared with traditional distributed space time codes.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Optical Orthogonal Code Pairs Based on Sequence Pairs
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new type of address code-Optical Orthogonal Code Pairs (OOCP) for Optical Code Division Multiple Access (OCDMA) system is presented in this paper according to the theory of sequence pair. Simultaneously, the concept of OOCP and correlation are defined, and OOCPs of capacity 1 are obtained by using exhaustive algorithm. Finally, OOCPs of larger capacity can be obtained by the recursive construction method.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Channel Allocation Strategy Based on TD-SCDMA Trunking System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: TD-SCDMA truncking system is a developing direction in digital truncking system. Based on TD-SCDMA trunking system, a movable boundary dynamic channel allocation (MB DCA) scheme is proposed. The characteristic of the algorithm is that the data service can borrow the voice channel for data transmission when the voice channel is idle and the data register queue is not empty. When a new voice call comes in, data service is blocked and voice service re-occupies the channel. The simulation results show that the channel utilization have an effectively improvement.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: The Preemption and Reservation Mechanism-Based Admission Policy for Multi-Priority Grid Operating
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The work admission policy which is suited for partial grid system is proposed in this paper. The strategy reserves resources for the general grid work from VIP user, as well as providing preemptive priority for general grid work to take up the service resources from best-effort work. The simulation results show that this strategy can qualify the work service for the general work from VIP user adequately when the work service quality of the general work from non-VIP user and best-effort work are least affected. At the same time, the number of reservation resource can be automatically adjusted due to the proportion between the intensity of general work and the best-effort work .

articleTitle: Selection Forward Routing (SFR): An On-Demand Routing Protocol for Mobile Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Flooding mechanism is widely used in ad hoc networks for its high reliability and coverage rate. However, flooding is inefficient for its large number of redundant messages and extortionate energy consumption. To support rapid route discovery without introducing too much route discovery traffic, an on-demand routing protocol for mobile wireless ad hoc networks, called Selection Forward Routing (SFR), is proposed in this paper. SFR carries on a constrained message forwarding for route discovery based on the node connectivity degree, which can consequently reduce the number of redundant messages introduced by flooding. SFR also integrates a better path search mechanism to try finding a better path to the specified destination node, while keeping the route discovery traffic relatively low. The simulation results show that in a mobile wireless ad hoc network, SFR has the same reliability and performance on route discovery as the flooding routing protocol, while reducing 30.2% energy consumption and 56.1% redundant messages introduced by the flooding routing protocol.

articleTitle: An Integrative System for Deep Packet Inspection and Network Anomaly Detection & Defense
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a security system which can accomplish several various functions. The primary applications of this system includes: (1) lawful interception for the data of voip, email, instant message and other kinds of data; (2) filtering abnormality data packages; (3) blocking the illegal URL or sites; (4) performing net traffic and flow analysis and user behavior analysis; (5) doing network bandwidth monitoring, DDOS traffic cleaning; (6) SPAM filtering and so on. All the problems we involved are the most concerned by the operators engaged in telecommunication. The system architecture and the function we designed are based on the research of Lawful Interception (ETSI).

articleTitle: Research on DTN Based Interconnecting ZigBee Network Techniques
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ZigBee network is a restricted wireless sensor network, and it has wide range of extensions. To solve the interconnection problems between ZigBee networks and IP networks, we propose an approach called DTN based Interconnecting ZigBee Network (DIZN), present the architecture and hierarchy communication protocol of DIZN system, study the main functions of the communication process in DIZN modules, and implement a prototype of DIZN. The experiment results of the prototype system indicate the feasibility of the DIZN.

articleTitle: Power ICT Network QoS Evaluation Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For meeting quality of services, it is proposed the Analytic Hierarchy Process evaluation model with the new generation power information and communication technology (ICT) network in this paper. Firstly, based on the characteristic of the network, the quality evaluation indicators are established and the parameters of the indicators are extracted. Finally the proposed method implements evaluation of dispatching management information system (DMIS). In this paper experimental results show that the presented approach is valid and rational.

articleTitle: On Minimizing Delay for MHWN Based on Multi-Hop Activity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a method for minimizing multi-hop transmission delay by optimally setting data rate along selected paths in Multi-hop Wireless Network (MHWN) based on multi-hop activity aware delay analysis. We develop an analytic model that enables us to obtain closed form expressions for delay in terms of multi-hop activity variables. A measuring deviation algorithm is used to derive the number of saturated nodes over a given set of topology. Numerical results and simulations are presented for different network topologies and compared with traditional studies.

articleTitle: Performance of MB-OWDM UWB in Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-band orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MB-OFDM) is an efficient approach for ultra-wideband (UWB). However, MB-OFDM is characterized by poor spectral properties that cause a high degree of spectral leakage and cyclic prefix symbol extension leads to a reduction of the bandwidth efficiency. Hence, Multicarrier transmission like orthogonal wavelet division multiplexing (OWDM) will become a better solution to OFDM. Further, in this paper, the performance of MB-OFDM UWB and MB-OWDM UWB in Rayleigh fading channels is evaluated and compared through computer simulations. In this evaluation the Bit error rate (BER) is used as performance measure.

articleTitle: Modeling IEEE 802.11 DCF under Nonsaturated Condition with Coupled Queues Effect
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For analysis of the IEEE 802.11 distributed coordination function (DCF) under nonsaturated condition, one of the key assumptions commonly accepted is that given the offered load, the queue utilizations of contending nodes are the same for all transmitted packets. In practice, however, this assumption is not valid due to coupled queues effect. In this paper, we investigate the influence brought by coupled queues and propose an accurate analytical model for IEEE 802.11-based networks under nonsaturated condition. The simulations show the accuracy of the analytical model.

articleTitle: A Model for Field Data Collection and Transmission in e-Science Applications
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: e-Science is one of the research hotspots in recent years, which focuses on how to apply IT on other disciplines. How to collect and transmit field data is an immediate problem should be solved in e-Science for those disciplines involving field observation. This paper brings out a system for field data collection and transmission in an automatic and high efficient way combined with several kinds of communication methods. A demonstration system has been developed in JAVA language to implement this system and has been verified to be good efficient in test.

articleTitle: Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Analysis of DC-OFDM Signals and Its Reduction Method
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a statistical analysis of peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) for complex-value OFDM signals and real-value OFDM signals using differential coding (DC) is presented. DC-OFDM has the good performance of compressing intercarrier interference (ICI) at the cost of high PAPR. Adjacent partial transmit sequence (PTS) is a proper method to reduce the PAPR of DC-OFDM. The simulation results show that the theoretic analysis is very close to experimental result. The complex-value DC-OFDM system exhibits near 2dB PAPR higher than the same type normal OFDM. PTS with V=4 can reduce the PAPR of DC-OFDM to the normal complex-value OFDM level.

articleTitle: Acquisition of BOC(n, n) with Large Doppler
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Binary Offset Carrier (BOC) modulation is used in Galileo and new generation of GPS. For the acquisition of BOC(n, n) signal with large frequency offset, a new method named secondary capture is proposed. Based on ASPeCT and Parallel Pseudo - Serial Doppler acquisition, this method consists of two steps. First the whole range of Doppler frequency is searched serially, then Doppler frequency is revised based on fast Fourier transform(FFT). Analysis and simulation results indicate that the method proposed in this paper can reduce capture error and improve capture probability especially for BOC(n, n) signal with large frequency offset.

articleTitle: Stability and Instance Optimality in Compressed Sensing with Regard to Some Measurement Matrices
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, it is proved that every s-sparse signal vector can be recovered stably from the measurement vector y = Ax via l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization as soon as the 2s-th restricted isometry constant of the measurement matrix A is smaller than 3/(4+√6). While for the large values of s, the constant can be improved to 4/(6 + √6)Note that our results contain the case of noisy data, therefore previous known results in the literature are extent and improved. Then we obtain the results on the stability and instance optimality for some random measurement matrices. Our results show there is a large family of measurement matrices which are suitable for compressed sensing.

articleTitle: A Modified Constellation Extension Scheme with Error Correction Capability for Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Reduction in OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The constellation extension scheme-partial transmit sequence (CES-PTS) scheme in a 16-QAM OFDM system is a novel PAPR reduction method with low computational loads. The CES-PTS scheme reduces the complexity of the constellation extension scheme (CES). Although the CES-PTS scheme has lower IFFT operations than the CES, the signals transmitted by the CES-PTS scheme have no error correction capabilities. Therefore, this paper proposes a modified CES-PTS scheme, called BCM-CES-PTS, that combines block coded modulation (BCM) codes with the CES-PTS scheme to improve the error correction capability of the CES-PTS scheme. This study further proposes a new mapping of 16-QAM constellation extension scheme to improve the PAPR performance of the CES scheme. Simulation results show that the BCM-CES-PTS scheme has better PAPR performance than the CES-PTS scheme when the number of subblocks is the same.

articleTitle: Design of a 3.1-10.6GHz CMOS Mixer for UWB Receiver
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a design of 3.1-10.6GHz down-converted mixer for ultra wideband (UWB) system with 0.18μm SMIC CMOS technology. The folded structure is adopted to lower voltage, at the same time, the current rescue technique and inductance negative feedback technology is used to trading-off the gain, the noise and the linearity. The good match over the entire frequency range is obtained by using passive components. The simulation result shows that the mixer achieves gain of 5.4dB, NF DSB of less than 16dB, the 1dB compression point of -2dB, IIP3 of 6dB with the power supply voltage of 1.8V, all characteristics of the design method have met the requirements of UWB systems perfectly.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a New Random Multi-Access Protocol with Acknowledgment Mechanism in Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a random multi-access protocol STPRM-A (slotted three-dimension probability random multi-access protocol with acknowledgement) for wireless communication. Performance of STPRM-A was evaluated by mathematical expression of channel throughput and delay of packet. The characteristic comparison between STPRM-A and PDPMRM was present. Experiment and simulation results validated correction of theoretical analysis, which also indicated that acknowledgement mechanism could affect transmission efficiency of wireless communication obviously.

articleTitle: Hybrid BCH-RSC Codes
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents a new scheme of hybrid codes, which are constructed by the parallel concatenation of serially concatenated and Bose Ray-Chaudhuri Hacquenghem (BCH) codes. The constituents of the serially concatenated code are BCH and Recursive Systematic Convolutional (RSC) codes, which are linked by the pseudo-random interleaver. The results obtained from different simulations confirm that with the reasonable number of iterations and careful puncturing, the newly proposed hybrid codes outperform BCH product codes. This is evident in the medium to high signal to noise ratios.

articleTitle: A Modified Two-Erose-Ring Model for MIMO Mobile-to-Mobile Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new geometrical two-erose-ring scattering model for the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) mobile-to-mobile (M2M) fading channels. In this model, the line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) components are all considered. Based on the geometrical model, a reference model and the corresponding simulation model are derived. Their statistical properties such as the three-dimensional (3D) space-time cross-correlation function (CCF), the two-dimensional (2D) spatial cross-correlation function (2D spatial CCF), and the temporal autocorrelation function (ACF) are studied. For computing the parameters of the simulation model, the extended method of exact Doppler spread (MEDS) are used. The close agreement between the statistical properties of the simulation model and those of the reference model are demonstrated. We believe that this research work is important for designers to develop, analysis, test, and optimization the future MIMO M2M communication systems.

articleTitle: The Analyzation on the Performance and Complexity of Sphere Decoding Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved sphere decoder (SD) and fixed-complexity sphere decoder (FSD) for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) wireless systems in detail. Furthermore, we analyze the performance and complexity of SD, FSD and other popular algorithms (such as Zero Forcing (ZF), Minimum Mean-Square Error (MMSE), Ordered Successive Interference Cancellation based on ZF criterion (ZF- OSIC) and MMSE criterion (MMSE-OSIC) and Maximum Likelihood (ML)) by comparing the Bit Error Rate (BER) and the average detection time consuming. Simulation based on the platform of MATLAB show that: (1) SD achieves the closest ML BER performance for a 4×4 MIMO system using QPSK, 16-QAM, and 64- QAM modulation; (2) the computation complexity of SD and FSD increases with the size of the constellation used; (3) when the SNR is lower than 3dB, the computation complexity of SD is higher than that of FSD; vice versa. FSD achieves the performance of quasi SD while overcoming the two main drawbacks of SD: variable complexity and sequential structure. This makes FSD more feasible for hardware implementation than SD.

articleTitle: 3.5 GHz to 10.0 GHz Mixers of High Gain and Good Isolations
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Signals in the communication system are carried by radio frequency EM waves whose frequencies are provided by Local Oscillators through the mixing function of mixers. They are received and unloaded again at where mixers are. Mixers with good isolation and linearity are highly appreciated. In this paper, mixers of high gain ranged from 3.5 GHz to 10 GHz are to be presented. The circuits are designed by the use of TSMC 0.18im CMOS model implanted in Agilent ADS. Based on Gilbert Cell Mixer [3], circuits with Vdd=1.38 volt are to be extended using extra passive devices to optimize the functioning. One is thus able to develop mixers with comparatively high gain of about 10 dB, improved isolations, and lower noise figures.

articleTitle: The Virtual Antenna of Measurement Report Based Methods for Wireless Location
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Though many location algorithms, such as least square methods, fingerprints, data fusion and proximity methods, have been suggested for positions estimation, most of their performances have been valuated based on the proposed simulations. The solution of distinguishing NLOS environments is still a Gordian knot. Our studies focus on the utilization of measurement report which is generated by the user equipment and contains the information of cell configurations and signal strengths. As the cell antenna azimuths which belong to the same base stations direct respectively, this paper suggests a notion of virtual antenna for wireless location in practical environment. The cells are categorized and a virtual antenna is defined to indicate mobile's direction more accurately. A step-by-step algorithm is also suggested for fitting the azimuths. The experiment of field measurements exhibits the high accuracies of our virtual antenna and a comparability of the fingerprints algorithm and our studies is shown.

articleTitle: Improved Analysis of Co-Channel Interference Suppression for WHT-STC-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: OFDM technology combined with STC has been used widely in modern communication systems, due to offering many advantages such as improving system capacity. Meanwhile it faces the mutual interference, such as CCI, which generated by multi-antenna transmitting at the receiver. Based on those advantages coming from the combination of STC-OFDM with WHT and the combination of STC-OFDM with ABF, an algorithm is proposed to suppress co-channel interference. Theoretical analysis and computer simulation showed the proposed algorithm could improve Symbol Error Rate performance and suppress CCI in STC-OFDM communication systems.

articleTitle: Determinant of the Sample Covariance Matrix Based Spectrum Sensing Algorithm for Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The presence of the primary signal changes not only the signal energy but also the correlation structure, a new spectrum sensing algorithm based on the determinant of the sample covariance matrix is then introduced. The new algorithm utilizes the fact that the determinant of the sample covariance matrixes of received signals is different from that of noise samples with high probability to detect whether the primary signal presents or not. Multivariate statistical theories are used to derive the theoretical decision threshold. The new method can execute spectrum sensing without the information about the primary signal and the communication channel. Simulation results show that the proposed method exhibits better performance than the maximum eigenvalue detection (MED) for moderate and low correlation received signals.

articleTitle: Feature Analysis for Exhaust Gas Temperature of Turbo Shaft Engine Based on Hilbert-Huang Transform
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new procedure based on Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) was proposed to investigate the change of the exhaust gas temperature (EGT) of turbo shaft engine. Energy-frequency-time distribution of the signal can be established though empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and Hilbert transform, from which Hilbert energy spectrum was obtained. The energy spectrum was applied to indicate the energy distribution of the signal on the frequency axis. The variation of EGT changing with time was researched by using instantaneous energy. At the same time, the signals of EGT were decomposed into intrinsic mode function, by which can eliminate the effect of noise on original signal. Feasibility of the method had already been verified by the tests.

articleTitle: The Coverage and Connectivity of Repeaters
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Coverage Model is constructed to meet the requirement that every point of the whole area is in the coverage of repeaters. The main algorithm is using small circles to cover the big circle with the rule that the distance between two circles' centers is not bigger than the radius of a repeater's coverage. To simplify the matter, we replace circles with particular regular hexagons, whose centers are locations to put repeaters. Using this model, we can work out the number of repeaters' locations.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of DSRC Protocol-Based ETC Data-Communication Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the data security, reliability problems of wireless communication in the ETC embedded data-communication system, this paper has analyzed the hardware structure which the system required, and paid an in-depth study on AES encryption algorithm that the hardware encryption engine applied. On this basis, the article has proposed the proposal that taking advantage of AES hardware encryption engine for full-text encryption of plain text in the wireless communication. Through experimental tests, it has proved the feasibility and the data wireless transmission security of ETC embedded data-communication system that the article designed.

articleTitle: Study on Coexisting Interference Detecting Algorithm for Ultra-Wideband Communications
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on Teager-Kaiser(TK) power computation operator, the novel coexisting narrow band interference(NBI) detecting algorithm for Ultra-wideband(UWB) communications is proposed in this paper. The novel algorithm can estimate the central frequency of NBI accurately by adding the standard frequency analog signal to the TK processing branch and using the discrepancy frequency information provided by the TK computation. The mathematic model and simulation analysis for the novel algorithm is made in this paper. The simulation results show that the measuring function of NBI central frequency can be finished efficiently. Furthermore, the novel algorithm can remove the analog mixer used widely in typical frequency measuring system and reduce the system processing complexity evidently, which can provide the important reference for development of adaptive anti-jamming technology and cognitive technology for UWB communications.

articleTitle: Constructions of ZCZ Sequences over 16-QAM Constellation Based on Binary ZCZ Sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The spread-spectrum communication systems making use of the spreading sequences over the QAM constellation are with high transmission data rate. In order to satisfy the above mentioned systems' requirement, the ZCZ sequences over 16-QAM constellation are discussed and three constructions for producing such sequences are presented from the known binary ZCZ sequences. Moreover, if the binary ZCZ sequences employed are optimal, the resultant constructions I and II are also optimal under their own conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Equalization and Precoding Joint Optimization Algorithm in MIMO AF Relay Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel equalization and precoding joint optimization algorithm is proposed in dual hop multiple input multiple output (MIMO) relay communication systems. This solution combines the equalization for the first phase and precoding for the second phase in relay system, therefore the joint optimization can be equaled with the unique optimization for the product matrix of detection and precoding, which avoid the non convergence problems in iterating process, compared with iterative optimization, the complexity burden of this algorithm is greatly reduced. And from simulation results the performance is only a little degraded. Therefore, when complexity and performance are considered, this algorithm reached a better compromise.

articleTitle: A New Joint Memory Polynomial and Look-Up-Table Predistorter Algorithm Design
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Digital baseband predistorter technology can effectively reduce the system nonlinear distortion. The memory polynomial algorithm and the look-up table (LUT) algorithm are two commonly used predistorter algorithms. In this paper, we analyze these two algorithms, and propose a new joint memory polynomial and LUT predistorter algorithm which picks up the advantages of the two algorithms. At last the new algorithm was optimized by linear interpolation method for further quantifiable performance improvement. Simulation results show that, in the Wiener amplifier model, the application of this new algorithm can speed up the algorithm convergence, save coefficients storage RAM and reduce computational complexity.

articleTitle: Image Retrieval Using Visually Significant Points
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To solve the question of the traditional points in image retrieval, a robust and self-adaptive point extraction algorithm is proposed in this paper. The block difference of inverse probabilities (BDIP) image is firstly obtained from the original image based on the BDIP model. According to the distribution feature of the BDIP image, the local points are extracted. Then, the color-spatial feature surrounding the local points is extracted as an index for image retrieval. Comparisons are conducted between this algorithm and other descriptors. Experimental results show that our method provides more significantly retrieval results than the traditional ones.

articleTitle: Spatial Correlation in Wireless Sensor Networks for Monitoring Application
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is a significant application of wireless sensor networks to monitor a mobile target. Multiple sensor nodes cooperate to get an accurate estimation of the signal of the mobile target. Spatial correlation, induced by the spatial distribution of target and sensor nodes, is an inherent phenomenon of wireless sensor networks. This correlation causes redundancy amongst nodes which create redundant information. In this paper, we analyze the spatial correlation phenomena when wireless sensor networks are used to track a mobile target. Compared with other works, we combine spatial and temporal factors to analyze the trace error.

articleTitle: A Robust Spatial DPI Suppression Algorithm for GSM-Based Passive Detection System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the major problems in GSM-based passive detection systems is how to suppress the strong direct path interference (DPI) effectively. According to the features of the GSM downlink signal and the DPI suppression requirement, a spatial filtering algorithm based on the direction of arrival (DOA) information and a least square null constraint optimization is proposed. Theoretical analyses and simulation results show that at least 55dB suppression gain can be achieved by using the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on GPS/SINS Integrated Navigation System Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: GPS/SINS is the main direction of integrated navigation system now for it has already considered as ideal, so it plays an important role in improving performance and precision of the integrated navigation system. This article focuses on the precision of IMU outputs, using discrete wavelet transform to de-noise the output information and completes kalman filtering with GPS, then puts these results into GPS/SINS integrated navigation system, eventually by static experiment with practical data to test and verify. Experiment results show that wavelet de-noising preprocessing can obviously improve the precision of navigation parameters and thereby improve the reliability of integrated navigation system.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Gain-Flattened Raman Amplifiers with Novel Highly Nonlinear Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to get a flat gain among the dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) channels, design and numerical analysis of Raman fiber amplifier (RFA) based on photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) have been done. Simple pure silica square PCFs with 5 rings air-hole and hexagonal PCFs with 8 rings air-hole owning high nonlinearity, low flat-dispersion as well as low confinement losses have been obtained. The designed PCFs are applied in RFA as gain medium and numerical results indicate that flat gain covering 1536 nm ~1565 nm band can be obtained by optimizing the center-to-center spacing between the air-holes and the air-hole diameter of the PCFs.

articleTitle: Research and Implement of PPP and TCP/IP Protocol Based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: General packet radio service (GPRS) is a packet oriented mobile data service on the 2G and 3G cellular communication systems global system for mobile communications (GSM). GPRS is the most widely used technology solutions to solve mobile communication combined with IP. Due to its advantage such as real-time online, binding billing, quick login, high-speed transmission, widespread coverage etc, it has been widely used in the remote monitoring and data transmission fields, etc. In this paper the PPP protocol of GPRS was researched in detail, moreover, the PPP protocol process based on GPRS was analyzed. In addition, it describes the composition and content, meaning and connection of the PPP protocol process and data exchange between terminal and monitoring center. Meanwhile, the TCP/ IP transmission protocol was discussed. it also gives three handshake data exchange situation which is connected by TCP/IP. It gives the specific application example of PPP and TCP/IP protocol exchanging data when connecting public wireless internet net with GPRS module. This article provides the essential basis for making further use of PPP and TCP/IP protocol to achieve the design of wireless transmission terminal.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Mine Mobile Information System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a high-risk industry, coal-mining's safety has always been a social focus. By using some emerging information technology, we propose an effective solution to improve the safety of coal-mining. In this paper, we design and implement a Mine Mobile Information System by integrating Internet of Things and Mobile Internet. With the client application developed on Android system, users could learn environment information and coal production anytime and anywhere. It should be much helpful for coal-mine enterprises to prevent accidents and to improve efficiency.

articleTitle: Improvement and Analysis of Multipath Routing Protocol AOMDV Based on CMMBCR
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile ad hoc network is a distributed wireless communication network, and energy issue has become a hot topic.CMMBCR considers the latest routing strategy about energy issue in ad hoc networks according to different situation , AOMDV multi-path routing protocol is improved based on the energy saving strategy CMMBCR.The improved protocol sets three node status and the nodes that do not work for a long time must be changed into sleep state,thus reducing the energy consumption of nodes. In order to validate the performance of the improved protocol which based on CMMBCR, it uses the simulation platform of NS2 to analyse the improved multipath routing protocol.The results show that, compared with AOMDV protocol the improved routing protocol which based on CMMBCR enhances the delivery rate and the energy costs also is greatly reduced, thus it advances the network performance to some degree.

articleTitle: Research on Fitting Telemetry Apparent Velocity by Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the fitting precision of telemetry apparent velocity, the question of finding spline fitting optimum nodes of telemetry apparent velocity is solved by the PSO algorithm. The method of parameter setting is given in the paper, and the computer simulations are done. The calculation simulation results show that the fitting effect by PSO algorithm is better than that by equidistance nodes and the NEWNOT.

articleTitle: Spatial-Community Resource Discovery Based on Spherical Migration in Mobile P2P Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at how to reduce energy consumption and improve the node survival cycle in mobile P2P network, SRDBSM was proposed. It uses the transmission characteristics of spatial node to search the optimal node which is considered as next-hop node within the maximum effective transmission range. It's not only reduces next-hop number and communion time, but also improves the efficiency of resource discovery. Theory analysis and experiments indicated that SRDBSM can improve some aspects including reducing node energy consumption; prolonging the network survival cycle and increasing the efficiency of resource discovery compared with Random Walk and Modified-BFS.

articleTitle: Fast Compressive Wideband Spectrum Sensing Based on Dictionary Linear Combination
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wideband spectrum sensing is applied to detect the unused spectrum hole for cognitive radios. Given the sparseness of the spectrum, the compressive sensing can be applied to the coarse sensing of spectrum. In the spectrum sensing, there are several spectrum bands in a frequency range with the same length.
