The study also proved that uncertainty is negatively related to trust in the process of online shopping. With high trust they would prefer to do window shopping.

articleTitle: Optimal Resource Allocation of Orthogonal Relay-Eavesdropper Channel
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The orthogonal relay-eavesdropper channel is investigated. The source communicates with the relay and the destination in channel 1, the relay communicates with the destination in channel 2, channel 1 and channel 2 are orthogonal with each other. The secrecy rate is derived based on the analysis of parallel relay- eavesdropper channel. Under the limit of the total channel resource, the maximal secrecy rate is obtained through optimizing the resource allocation parameter a. In the Gaussian channel, when eavesdropper listen the signals of channel 1, it is proved that there exists the unique a to reach the maximum secrecy rate and a higher secrecy rate can be achieved using the optimal resource allocation strategy than the equal resource allocation strategy.

articleTitle: Self-Organizing Load Balancing for Network Measurement Server Cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Self-organizing and load balancing are both important research directions today, but there is not much similar research in network measurement server. In this paper we firstly investigate the overhead proportion of network measurement server by analyzing actual data. And then a model of self-organizing and load balancing server cluster is proposed, along with the estimation algorithms of single integrated computing ability under server cluster and the algorithms of self-organizing. At last an experiment was done to prove the correctness and the feasibility of our model and algorithms, as well as the good performance of the server cluster.

articleTitle: Pricing Scheme for Limiting Strategic Bidding on Sponsored Search Auction
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We prove that the forward looking Nash equilibrium (FLNE) from the angle of dynamic strategic bidding is the subset of locally envy-free equilibrium. For limiting vindictive bidding in GSP and "sawtooth" bidding in GFP, we introduce a new pricing strategy and analyse its equilibrium and properties.

articleTitle: Capacity Analysis of CDMA System Supporting Data Services
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an analysis method on service capacity of CDMA system supporting data services. Cell spectrum efficiency and access available space the two concepts are used to constructed a new network performance evaluation system. An application layer service model and its corresponding cross-layer mapping method are also proposed. Based on the interference-limited CDMA system, we analysis the influence of different service characteristics for network performance both in single-service and multi-services condition.

articleTitle: Channel Aware Joint Optimization of Latency and Distortion for Image Communications
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In some online transcoding applications, such as web browsing, web contents are transcoded into the same or a different format to reduce bandwidth consumption and speed up web access for narrow bands, such as wireless channels. In addition to the rate-distortion performance of the transcoder, transcoder complexity plays a crucial role in real time transcoding applications, since it directly affects the total access latency. This paper proposes and formulates the joint optimization problem of latency and distortion, which is related to both the rate-distortion performance and the complexity of the transcoder. A practical solution is presented to choose the right transcoder based on the available bandwidth at the time of transcoding, so as to minimize the total latency for a given distortion constraint. This is especially useful for wireless communications where the available bandwidth keeps changing due to different contributing factors.

articleTitle: Network Coding from Algebraic Curves
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Our aim is to present a new construction of network coding from algebraic curves over finite fields. Moreover, the Reed-Solomon-like code construction introduced by Ralf Kotter in his paper coding for errors and erasures in random network coding is one simple case of our construction.

articleTitle: A MCS Selection Strategy Based on Ordered Modulation for IEEE 802.11n System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The main application of IEEE 802.11n MIMO-OFDM system focuses on transmitting HD video in WLAN. In this paper, we propose an ordered modulation scheme based on IEEE 802.11n with multiple optional modulation and coding schemes (MCS) to achieve unequal error protection (UEP) for the HD video transmission. In the scheme, the most significant bits (MSB) are mapped into the spatial streams utilizing low-level modulation, while the least significant bits (LSB) are mapped into the streams utilizing high-level modulation. Based on this UEP scheme, we propose a selection strategy to choose the optimal MCS among candidates for a specific data rate, where the MCS with best peak-signal-noise-ratio (PSNR) is selected for HD video transmission. Simulation results show that this UEP scheme and selection strategy can obviously improve the PSNR performance of the received videos.

articleTitle: The Communication Performance of Individual Soldier Radio with a Carrier Frequency of 2.4 GHz
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The communication performance of radio with a carrier frequency of 2.4GHz is researched. Firstly, the correction rule of path loss when the radio used in different geographical environment is present; then the formulas of communication distance and anti-jamming performance is deduced at first time. In the end, helpful concrete data about both communication distance and anti-jamming performance in different condition is obtained by simulation and analysis.

articleTitle: A New Relay Architecture for Interference Management and Capacity Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Prior studies on relay architectures mainly focused on single cell scenarios and the impact of various forms of interference (i.e. relay-to-relay and base- station-to-relay) is often ignored. A new relay architecture is proposed to tackle the inter-cell interference problem. It significantly outperforms other relay schemes in SINR coverage and spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Fractional Frequency Offset Estimation Polarity Reversion Elimination for 3GPP LTE-A System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Noise and channel fading induced fractional frequency offset (FFO) estimation polarity reversion degrades the frequency synchronization performance inevitably. An efficient FFO polarity detection method is proposed in Long Term Evolution Advanced (LTE-A) to solve the problem, which utlize the mirror symmetry property of time-domain Primary Synchronization Symbol (PSS) signals. Numerical results show that the proposed method can depress FFO polarity reversion efficiently.

articleTitle: A Novel Routing Algorithm of SRLG Constraints with Conditional Failure Probability in Mesh Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Considering Share Risk Link Group (SRLG) constraints , a algorithm called SRLG with Conditional Failure probability (SCFP) is proposed in order to provide differentiated services in WDM mesh network. SCFP can differentiate the requirement on service reliability based on analysis of Conditional Failure Probability (CFP). In this algorithm, the concept of CFP is provided from reliability probability that user requires. Then a pair of routes satisfying CFP is computed, and also the routing trap is solved. Simulation results show that SCFP effectively reduces the Blocking probability and keeps in a high resource utilization rate.

articleTitle: A SVD Based SRUKF Algorithm of Single Observer Passive Location
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A square root unscented kalman filter algorithm based on singular valued decomposition is presented to enhance the robustness in the single observer passive location. The Cholesky decomposition or update is replaced by singular value decomposition, so the new method solves the unstable problem of SRUKF (Square Root unscented kalman filter) which is caused by covariance matrix morbidity in strong nonlinear cases. The simulation results show that the filtering algorithm of SVD-SRUKF proposed in this paper has higher stability and accuracy than any other similar algorithm.

articleTitle: Online-to-Mobile Trust Transference: An Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The objective of this research is to reveal the mechanisms associated with the initial formation of people's trust in mobile banking. And this research fills a research gap by focusing on online to mobile trust transfer process, which has received almost no attention. For this, we attempt to understand the effect of four antecedent factors (perceived security, perceived privacy protection, compatibility and relative advantage) on shaping a customer's initial trust in mobile banking. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of customers' online banking trust on the initial trust in mobile banking and its antecedents. The study tests hypothesis by using a sample of 313 cell-phone users who have used online banking before. Results show that online trust positively influence initial trust in mobile banking and customers' perceived security and privacy protection of mobile banking. Thus, online-to-mobile trust transfer process should be considered when designing multichannel strategies and attracting customers to use mobile banking.

articleTitle: A Fusion Decision Algorithm Based on Channel Estimation in Cognitive Radio System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Fusion decision plays an important part in the cooperation sensing of cognitive radio. In this paper, a fusion decision algorithm based on channel estimation (FD_CE) is proposed in the architecture of central cooperative sensing in cognitive radio. Instead of the traditional hard decision methods such as AND, OR, Most, we consult to a soft decision algorithm which combines all the detected information of different secondary user (SU) by a linear weight of their channel gains. The algorithm proposed has evaluated the reliability about each secondary user's radio environment, so it brings a better sensing performance. Simulation results show that a higher probability of detection can be achieved using the proposed algorithm comparing with single node sensing, cooperative sensing by AND and OR rules; meanwhile, it decrease the detection threshold effectively at the same time, which means saving single node's hardware cost in other words.

articleTitle: Watermarking Algorithm for Vector Point Clusters
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a digital watermarking algorithm for protecting vector point data from illegal use. Three rules of watermarking, i.e. usability, invisibility, and robustness, are taken into account, and corresponding measures, including shuffling image before embedding, selecting feature points, and utilizing the least significant bits (LSBs) as insertion positions, are employed to implement the rules. Based on the measures, an approach to watermark embedding for point data is developed. Firstly, the original watermark (an image) is shuffled; secondly the feature points of the data are obtained by an iterative process. then the watermark is embedded in the LSBs of the coordinates of the feature points. To detect the watermark, a similar process for obtaining the feature points in watermark embedding is carried out first; then the LBSs of the coordinates of the feature points are assigned to a one-dimensional array to form a bit chain; after this, a reverse process of watermark shuffling is done to form a two-dimensional image; finally the similarity degree between the image and the original watermark is calculated for judging whether the data contains the watermark or not. Our experiments show the technique can resist the attacks from data compressing and format changes.

articleTitle: Research on Congestion Control Routing Algorithm for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Based on Node Degree Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ad Hoc network is recently a hot spot in wireless network researching domain. The design of routing algorithm, which is as the core layer technology in Ad Hoc networks, has drawn great concern. After analyzing the drawbacks of the existing algorithms, this paper puts forward a congestion control routing algorithm based on the node degree. This paper explains the principle of the node degree algorithm; we select nodes with low degree to forward data packets in the process of routing searching. Results of simulation show: number of relay nodes is reduced significantly in the process of routing setup.

articleTitle: A Movement Control Policy Based on Probabilistic Coverage Model for Mobile Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The design problems of localization algorithm, distribution density estimation and node's moving path for data collection in multi-layers mobile wireless senor network are investigated. To ensure estimating accurately the node density, this paper proposes a new movement control strategy for fusion nodes based on probabilistic coverage model. This method completed the unknown node localization through beacon nodes traversing the monitoring area, and estimated distribution density of nodes in the network based on probabilistic coverage model, and divided the nodes into groups as little as possible, and constructed the short path of the fusion node's data collection according to the centers of these limited groups. The results of the experiments indicated that the control policy of mobile fusion nodes can reduce greatly network energy, and prolong network lifetime.

articleTitle: Multicast Routing Algorithm Balancing Network Load Based on Immune Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A multicast QoS routing algorithm based on immune genetic algorithm to balance the load in the network was proposed. This paper proposes the network model which supports QoS multicast. With the optimization of existing QoS multicast routing algorithms, this paper proposes an improved multi-constrained for load balancing QoS multicast routing algorithm based on immune genetic algorithm. The simulation results indicate that the algorithm has high convergence speed and reliability, and can meets the demand of QoS multicast.

articleTitle: PAPR Reduction of OFDM Using a Novel Concatenated PS-PTS Method
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Partial transmit sequences (PTS) and Pulse shaping (PS) are two effective techniques for reducing the peak to average power ratio (PAPR) of OFDM system. The main disadvantage of PS method is spectrum loss, and PTS has high computation complexity. A new combined technique of PS and PTS is proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that the proposed concatenated technique achieved a better performance on reducing PAPR of OFDM system while inhibiting the main drawbacks of each original method.

articleTitle: The Algorithm for Deep-Space Weak Signal Tracking Using a Modified Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In Deep-space TT&C and communication, the received signal is very weak, so the traditional Kalman Filter is hard to track the signal accurately. In this paper, a modified Kaman Filter using least squares (LS) method is presented to address this issue. This method is good at tracking amplitude, phase, frequency and its time derivatives of frequency (the signal with low carrier acquisition threshold and high dynamic). Computer simulation shows that the lower carrier power -157dBm can be achieved with this method.

articleTitle: A New Solution to GNSS Receiver Baseband Signal Processing SOC Platform Based on OpenRISC Processor
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new solution to GNSS receiver baseband signal processing SoC platform based on OpenRISC CPU is presented. The system hardware structure of the SoC platform on Xilinx FPGA is built. The GNSS correlator which is implemented in Xilinx FPGA is presented. OpenRISC CPU and Wishbone are migrated and OpenRISC software functions are expounded. The proposed SoC platform is useful to design a low cost GNSS baseband ASIC chip with flexibility, openness and freeness.

articleTitle: A Write-Optimized B-Tree Layer for NAND Flash Memory
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For B-tree index structure which requires intensively fine-grained updates/modifications, directly implementing this index structure over flash memory could lead to a significant number of write operations. In this paper, a write-optimized B-tree layer is proposed called WOBF which works over FTL in the flash memory. It could not only reduce the number of write operations by buffering index units in the index buffer and handling them in a batch, but also eliminate the number of pages used to store the index units reflecting the modified node. The performance benefits are proven theoretically and validated empirically.

articleTitle: Designing and Porting Boot Loader and uClinux with Its Implementation Based on LPC2478
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As various applications have been developped for different intention in Embedded System the combination of bootloader and uClinux which is as the base of those plays a more and more important role. uClinux,a linux distribution designed for processors without a Memory Management Unit (MMU), is the operating system that assorts with the device drivers, the platform for applications and the core of Embedded System. Additionally, the boot loader is a program that loads the main operating system. Transparently, boot loader which initializes necessary environment should execute before uClinux. Therefore, those two are feasible on LPC2478, a processor without MMU from NXP semiconductors. This paper introduces the configuration of boot loader and uClinux and represents a whole process of porting boot loader and uClinux on LPC2478.

articleTitle: Nodes Localization Algorithm for Linear Wireless Sensor Networks in Underground Coal Mine Based on RSSI-Similarity Degree
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the problems that non-line-measurement error is easily produced in narrow roadway and RSSI values are seriously influenced by underground coal mine environment, a dynamic a localization algorithm based on RSSI-similarity degree(DaLA-RSD) is proposed. The algorithm uses the information between tested beacon nodes group and the other side's two adjacent beacon nodes groups to get path loss index a of each location, in order to reduce the non-line-measurement error and obtain accurate measurement of distance. On the basis of this case, desired beacon nodes are selected to locate by RSSI-similarity degree and group number. Simulation results show that the algorithm has higher localization accuracy than maximum likelihood estimation localization algorithm(MLELA).

articleTitle: A Novel Time and Frequency Synchronization Algorithm for LTE System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a time and frequency synchronization algorithm for LTE-TDD (Long Term Evolution-Time Division Duplex) system downlink, which can provide accurate symbol timing synchronization and frequency synchronization for UE (User Equipment). We introduce a simplified ML (Maximum Likelihood) algorithm and present a method using PSS (Primary Synchronization Signal) in wireless frame to get time and frequency synchronization respectively. Simulation results show that, under different channel environments, the synchronization algorithm can work better with a small and simple computational complexity.

articleTitle: An Interpolation-Based Frequency Estimator Synthetic Approach for Sinusoid Wave
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In view of the existing characteristics that the frequency estimator precision of Rife algorithm and Rife-based improved algorithm have a notable decline when SNR is lower, a new synthetic frequency estimator approach based on interpolation (NSAI) is presented, which integrates both zoom-FFT technology and Rife-based interpolation. The zoom-FFT and interpolation are employed to complement each other by the new estimator of NSAI to improve the precision of frequency estimation and immunity in noise. The simulation results indicate that NSAI not only has an estimation precision of approach CRB(Cramer-Rao lower bound) under the condition of low SNR, but also has a good stability in all frequency domains. The new estimator of NSAI needs only once FFT and two points DFT, therefore it can be achieved in real-time.

articleTitle: Issues for Event Monitoring in Event-Driven Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper gives out a survey on event monitoring in Event-driven wireless sensor networks (EWSNs). In EWSNs, there are mainly two tasks, one is accurate event detection with higher detection probability and lower false-alarm probability. The other is reliable dissemination of the event information after accurate detection. In this paper, we firstly address the design issues for event detection and reliable dissemination, and then some existing detection scheme and dissemination protocols for event information are introduced and compared. Finally, several problems to be solved are outlined.

articleTitle: Opportunistic and Fairness Scheduling Mechanism for Wireless Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Network coding can greatly improve the throughput and power efficiency of wireless networks by mixing packets from different flows into a single one before forwarding. However, packets need to wait for its correspondences before coding, which may induce additional delay and packet loss. Considering the diversity of traffic flows and the stochastic nature of the packet arrival process in wireless networks, we propose an Opportunistic and Fairness Scheduling (OFS) mechanism for wireless network coding. The relay node can transmit either network-coded or un-coded packets. Traffic arrival rate and queue state are the two most important facts that determine a packet's transmission with or without network coding. Finally, we discuss the impact of different parameters on the performance of OFS through simulations and show the effectiveness and fairness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: AODV Protocol Optimization Based on Cross-Layer Design of WMN
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes AODV Routing cross-layer based on multiple criteria optimization mechanism to solve the network congestion caused by node load imbalance. This mechanism is proposed by integrating the minimum hop of the network layer and the interference and data rates of physical layer. Then through theoretical analysis and NS2 simulation, the experiment results prove this mechanism has a lower data frame loss rate, latency and throughout, therefore, routing performance is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Study on Delay Boundary Based on SNC in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Delay boundary is an important topic for evaluating the service performance of network. In this paper, we focus on the delay boundary of the end-to-end in wireless sensor networks (WSN). We propose stochastic arrive curve model and stochastic service curve model based on stochastic network calculus (SNC), which can be applied to analyze the service performance of WSN. Then we derive the end-to-end delay boundary. The numerical results indicate that the single node delay boundary and the end-to-end delay boundary will change rapidly under different parameters. The results play an important role for quality of service in WSN.

articleTitle: A Bandwidth Allocation Algorithm and Its Performance Analysis Based on IEEE 802.16d Standard
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm of bandwidth allocation based on wireless access network 802.16d standard. First distributes the bandwidth in different services then redistributes the bandwidth in different connection of one service. By the test of simulation platform of the IEEE 802.16 using OPNET, the algorithm guarantees time-delay of the real-time polling service and it also satisfies the fairness of the different services.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Equipment Management System Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using today's popular architectural concepts of the Internet of Things (IoT), through RFID and agreed protocol, we described the program of objects within a specific space with internet connectivity and data communication. In this paper, we achieved things on object identification, tracking and monitoring. Based on the platform of Visual Studio 2008 and SQL Server database which provided by the Microsoft, we have designed the front-end software interface of the smart equipment management system and the back-end database, which interacted with the readers through the sockets and passed information.

articleTitle: The Simulation of WLAN Outdoor Coverage in Hot Spot Area for Wireless Digital City
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Firstly, the technical features and frequency characteristics of IEEE802.11x protocol in wireless local area network (WLAN) are introduced. The uplink and downlink radio power budget of current WLAN outdoor coverage is given. The functional relationship of path loss and coverage distance in dense urban is shown in figures. Secondly, hot spot area WLAN outdoor coverage signal strength simulation has been done in dense urban for several situations by using simulation software. The results of simulation validate the accuracy of the calculation for uplink/downlink power budget and path loss in WLAN 2.4GHz band. Finally, a valuable hot spot area WLAN outdoor coverage deployment suggestion is given: high power WLAN BTS/AP and high gain antenna with 4 sectors deployment will improve the uplink/downlink power budget and enlarge radio coverage in hot spot area. The analysis in this paper is significant for the deployment of wireless digital city.

articleTitle: A Load Balancing Relay Selection Algorithm for Relay Based Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A load balancing relay selection algorithm (LB-RS) is presented for relay based cellular networks. According to current user channel conditions as well as the user numbers that relay serves, LB-RS chooses the optimal relay node for each user in a distributed way. Simulation results demonstrate that compared with other relay selection schemes, LB-RS can achieve load balancing through effective relay selection method. This is realized by jointly consider physical layer parameters as well as MAC layer parameters, so as to obtain a tradeoff between the system throughput and the user equity.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Users

articleTitle: Extension of 4-Tx Precoding Codebook to 8-Tx Downlink Closed-Loop MIMO
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The codebook based precoding is an effective form of limited feedback closed-loop multiple input multiple output (MIMO) scheme. An efficient methodology to build low complexity and high performance codebook is crucial for the closed-loop MIMO precoding algorithm. In this paper, we present a simplified codebook design scheme for 8-Tx MIMO based on the 4-Tx codebook in LTE Rel-8 and Kronecker product. In additional to low complexity and good backward compatibility properties, the codebook design based on this method can inherit most of the desired properties of Rel-8 codebook.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Power Allocation for OFDM-Based Cognitive Radio Systems with Imperfect Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on existing sensing technology, namely imperfect spectrum sensing, we study an energy efficient power allocation problem for OFDM-based cognitive radio systems, and its optimal solution is derived, and further an energy efficient power allocation scheme is proposed. The proposed scheme can not only save valuable resource such as battery life by selectively allocating power to underutilized sub carriers, but also fully make use of the limited spectrum resource.

articleTitle: An Efficient Proportional Resource Allocation Algorithm in MIMO-OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dynamic resource allocation (DRA) in MIMO- OFDMA systems supporting multiple services is studied. A low complexity linear algorithm based on solving an RA optimization problem subject to an additional proportional fairness constraint is developed. Computer simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs well, and the proportionality of rate among the users approaches the proportional rate constraint as the increasing of the available subcarriers. Furthermore, it has a lower computational complexity.

articleTitle: A Network Coding Based Data Dissemination Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the functions of data dissemination are distributing codes to destination nodes and update their function. Because of the limitation of the sensors' power in WSNs, the process of data dissemination should be reliable and quick. Considering network coding has many advantages such as strong practicality, simple operation and fitting for robust and distributed transmission, in this paper, we present a data dissemination scheme based on random linear network coding. The key idea of proposed scheme is to combine random linear network coding with flooding protocol in network layer protocol. By means of encoding native packets, proposed scheme increases the reliability of communication and reduces the number of packets which is sent by sink. Thus, delay time of network is reduced. Simulation results display that the proposed scheme can reduce average delay of the overall network by 50%. Especially, as the size of native packet increases, the performance of proposed scheme becomes better.

articleTitle: On the Design of Quasi-Orthogonal Space-Time-Frequency Block Code over MIMO OFDM Channel
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a Space-Time-Frequency block code (STFBC) based on Quasi-Orthogonal designs is proposed over a frequency selective Rayleigh fading channel. The proposed code achieves rate-one and full diversity offered by the MIMO-OFDM channel. For quasi-static channel over adjacent OFDM symbol durations, as numerical results demonstrate, the proposed code introduces a significant performance gain over the existing STFBC codes in terms of bit error rate performance. By coding across the three dimensions with four frequency diversity branches, the proposed code has a four-wise maximum likelihood decoding. The system performance will be investigated under different delay spread of the channel. In addition, a performance comparison for different FFT size will be presented.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Cluster-Based Cooperative MIMO Scheme Using Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless Sensor networks (WSNs) require energy-efficient and robust communication protocols. Cooperative MIMO transmission is one of the new solutions. In this paper, we propose an Energy-efficient Cluster-based Cooperative MIMO transmission scheme using Network Coding, termed as ECCM-NC. Network coding algorithm is applied to reduce the energy and time consumption in intra-cluster information exchange procedure. An optimization model is developed to find the optimum cooperative nodes number, clusters number and transmission rates. Simulation shows that tremendous energy saving is possible with application of network coding and judicious choice of designed protocol parameters even considering the local circuit energy cost and STBC training overhead.

articleTitle: High-Accuracy Bias Control Software for Doherty RF Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to accurately control the gate bias voltage of a Doherty RF power amplifier is an important problem that has to be resolved for developing high efficiency RF power amplifiers. This paper proposes a digital bias solution to obtain adjustable accurate bias voltage, and discusses the implementation procedure of high-accuracy bias voltage control software for Doherty RF power amplifiers in detail. The software can not only precisely adjust the bias voltage of a PA to determine the optimal bias point of the PA, but also can be used to build an automatic optimization and debugging system for the power amplifier so as to reduce the fabrication costs of debugging and testing power amplifiers.

articleTitle: Uplink Channel-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for LTE-Advanced System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: in this paper, a new uplink channel-aware scheduling algorithm is proposed to improve the cell throughput and cell-edge user throughput for 3GPP Long Term Evolution Advanced (LTE-A) in case of equal power allocation among subcarriers. The target is to maximize the priority-sum under the constraint of limited power of User Equipment (UE). For the purpose, the algorithm to determine the reallocated RBs set and UEs, and the optimization procedures of reallocated RBs are proposed, from which, we design a new resource allocation algorithm. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme enhances the cell throughput and cell-edge user throughput by 11% and 20% respectively

articleTitle: Service Reliability Analysis Using Competing Risk Models
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The survival and failure analysis provide a lot of information regarding reliability and maintainability of systems. Arriving at suitable distribution and parameterization of data helps predicting the behavior of systems. Mobile communication has become one of the most valued and indispensable service sector due to its commercial, financial and entertainment applications, apart from usual verbal use. There have been dedicated efforts to improve its versatility, transportability and equipment quality. But lack of infrastructural facilities and the neglect of 'industrial best practices' has made this sector less dependable. The end to end availability of the network depends up on the reliability of each element in the series. Here I am analyzing six months live data of a network with about 2360 BTS serving 3.5 million customers using competing risk models. Both physical as well as the capacity related issues are focused together to get better idea of availability. The failure restoration time distribution patterns are arrived from the data.

articleTitle: Application of Long-Distance Wireless Communication Technologies in Automatic Water Metering System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through comprehending the structure of automatic water metering systems based on wireless communication technologies, as well as understanding of characteristics and service range for the common long-distance wireless communication methods, furthermore, combined with our experiences gained in practical projects, this paper gives a brief description for the choice of wireless communication methods in automatic water metering system.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Beamforming Algorithms in the TD-LTE System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to reduce multi-access interference and increase system throughput, beamforming algorithms are introduced into the LTE system. These three beamforming algorithms based on LMS, eigenvalue decomposition and conjugate normalization are studied in this paper, making simulation and comparison of the performances of these three algorithms on the simulation platform of LTE system. The results show that in the static environment, the performances of beamforming algorithms based on the eigenvalue decomposition and conjugate normalization are equivalent, the performances of them are better than LMS algorithm's. And due to small computation, the conjugate normalization algorithm is consequently more practical. Meanwhile, the influences of the parameters of the granularity of the weights, different antenna configuration, ETU channel model and UE movement speed on the performances of beamforming algorithms are also simulated and studied. Results show that under the same conditions, the smaller the granularity of the weights is, the better the performance is; the better the correlation between antennas is, the better the performance is; the smaller the UE movement speed is, the better the performance is.

articleTitle: Wideband Doherty Power Amplifier for WiMAX Application
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this work, an integrated Doherty power amplifier in 0.18 μm CMOS process is presented for WiMax applications at 2.5 GHz. Doherty configuration with cascode structure is adopted to achieve high efficiency and output power. The scaling and transistor size of main and peaking amplifier is iteratively determined to result optimum power splitting between main and peaking amplifiers. The uneven power splitting helps the peaking amplifier to generate enough current so that proper load modulation is achieved. The proposed power amplifier provides a maximum output power of 24 dBm and a power added efficiency (PAE) as high as 41% at 2.5 GHz operation frequency. At 1-dB compression point this PA exhibits 22 dBm of output power with 33% PAE.

articleTitle: Ad Hoc Networks Multi-Channel MAC Protocol Design and Channel Width Adaptation Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless Ad hoc networks, using multi-channel technique on MAC layer to increase the network capacity is a promising technology. By extending the RTS/CTS mechanism of IEEE802.11 standard, we propose a busy tone-based multi-channel MAC protocol, which can significantly improve the network throughput by using busy tone to distribute the multiple channels and overcome the multi-channel hidden terminal problem. On the basis of the protocol, this paper further takes the advantage of channel width adaptation technique, with which one channel can be effectively divided into several sub-channels so that the collision probability can be decreased and the network throughput can be further improved. NS2 simulation results show that, firstly, the proposed MAC protocol can significantly improve the throughput via using multiple channels and the improvement on throughput is in direct ratio to the number of channels; Secondly, without increasing the total bandwidth, dividing a channel into several sub-channels via the technique of channel width adaptation can also improve the network performance.

articleTitle: Relay Selection with Constellation Rearrangement for Superposition Modulation Cooperative Relay
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider a multi-relay Demodulate-and-Forward (DMF) cooperation system, in which the high order superposition modulation (SM), superposition 16-QAM modulation (16-QAM SM), is employed. For the given system, a new relay selection scheme with constellation rearrangement (CR) technique is proposed, which is based on the optimal total mutual information (MI) criterion. Firstly we find the optimal bit-symbol mappings for all the relays. And then the source chooses the best relay, which maximizes the MI, to cooperate with. We assume that all the channel state information (CSI) is available. A variety of simulations are performed and show that they match exactly with analytic ones. In addition, the result shows that our new strategy utilizing high order superposition modulation with CR outperforms the classical SM cooperation scheme and traditional DMF scheme for about 1.5 dB and 2.5 dB, respectively. Meanwhile, it improves spectrum efficiency with the same complexity.

articleTitle: Implementation and Design of Carrier Recovery Loop for High Order QAM Signals
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on coordinate rotation digital computer (CORDIC) algorithm and phase frequency detector (PFD), a new design of digital carrier recovery loop for high order QAM signals was presented. The loop initially operated in polarity decision algorithm (PDA) under fast and slow modes which were set in loop filter (LPF) to capture the frequency offset. When the frequency offset was captured, the loop switched to decision direct algorithm (DDA) to decrease the phase jitter. We proposed digital direct frequency synthesizer (DDFS) under CORDIC algorithm, with more accuracy and more feasibility on very large scale integrated circuits (VLSI) implementation of carrier recovery circuit than conventional look-up table. Simulations showed the good performance of this design. By FPGA implementation, the efficiency was proved.

articleTitle: A New Face Detection Method with GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the BP neural network improved by the genetic algorithm (GA) is applied to the problem of human face detection. GA is used to optimize the initial weights of the BP neural network to make full use of its global optimization and local accurate searching of the BP algorithm. Matlab Software and its neural network toolbox are used to simulate and compute. The experiment results show that the GA-BP neural network has a good performance for face detection. Furthermore, compared with the conventional BP algorithm, the GA-BP learning algorithm has more rapid convergence and better assessment accuracy of detecting quality.

articleTitle: A New Mobile Streaming System Base-On Http Live Streaming Protocol
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Proposed a new Mobile Streaming System that can support live broadcasts, video on demand an time- shifted base-on Http Live Streaming Protocol, with a cross-platform client, litter constraints of server network, and user accessing media data from web server. Media encoding format is mpeg + mp3 , using m3u8 file format to index and organize the media data.

articleTitle: A Matching Game Algorithm for Spectrum Allocation Based on POMDP Model
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For managing spectrum effectively in cognitive radio system, a matching game algorithm for spectrum allocation based on POMDP model is proposed. Cognitive users can maximize reward of system through observation statistics of historical information, and adjustment their matching strategy. The simulation results show that the approach realizes efficient allocation of the spectrum resource.

articleTitle: Enhancing Personal Information Security on Android with a New Synchronization Scheme
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile phones which use Android or other smartphone operating systems, equipped with richer applications than traditional ones, enable users to leave more things to phones to deal with. As a result, personal information stored on mobile phones becomes more and more. It is well known that backup is an important means to keep the information safe. However, users could only sync their contacts, sms, etc. to the Internet and easily sync back these information if necessary. Application settings such as activations, game scores and so on are also important to users. The lost of personal information caused by mobile phone updates, replacement and lost becomes not uncommon in recent days. It is urgent to propose a better application settings integration and management scheme. This article raises a solution on Android platform after a study to Android security mechanisms and system components.

articleTitle: Rapid Deployment Wireless Text Messaging Network for Disaster Relief
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Public communication infrastructures are vulnerable to catastrophic events and are often incapacitated when disaster hits. An airborne Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) with Global Special Mobile (GSM) Short Message Service (SMS) capability is proposed as a rapidly deployable emergency communication network (ECN) solution. A SMS-WSN ECN node prototype is developed and encapsulated in a weatherproof and airdrop capable shell. A cargo aircraft loaded with the ECN nodes can be quickly deployed to an affected area. Thousands of nodes can be distributed to form a complementary SMS network capable of relaying text messages among all GSM users. Test results verified the viability of relaying GSM text messages via WSN link, thus proved the concept of providing SMS among cellular users during disaster, to assist in saving human life.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Simulation of Photovoltaic Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The use of new efficient photovoltaic (PV) solar cells has emerged as an alternative measure of renewable green power, energy conservation and demand-side management. The power generated by a PV cell depends on the operating voltage of the array; its voltage-current and voltage-power characteristic curves specify a unique operating point at which maximum possible power is delivered and the array is operated at its highest efficiency. In this paper, dynamic modeling and simulation of photovoltaic energy conversion system (PVECS) is presented. The maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control for PVECS is also addressed in this paper. The whole system has been developed and simulated using Matlab/Simulink environment. Simulation studies have been carried out to verify the system performance. The results show that the overall power management strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a SoC-Based Single Chip Radio Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This work introduces the concept and advantages of single chip radio, a highly integrated and novel radio systems. The System-on-Chip (SoC) design methodology is suggested to satisfy strict requirements on power consumption, module cost, chip size and reliability in wireless applications such as WSN, Bluetooth, WLAN and so on. Integrate the whole wireless transceiver system into one single chip can greatly minimize its size and decrease manufacturing costs. The paper presents architecture in single chip radio system and several important components in circuit implementation, such as low noise amplifier (LNA), power amplifier (PA), mixer and micro-strip antenna. Finally, the development trends and challenges of single chip radio are also discussed.

articleTitle: A SPC-Based Adaptive RTO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present an adaptive retransmission timeout (RTO) algorithm. It can improve the performance of Jacobson's algorithm by using Statistic Process Control (SPC) method. According to the trend of round-trip time (RTT) distributions, the algorithm uses different parameters to handle the impulsive characteristic of RTTs, whereby the RTO can be adjusted more timely and intelligently. The new algorithm is based on Jacobson's algorithm. Therefore, it adapts to any network in which Jacobson's algorithm can be used, and is compatible with any Transmission Control Protocol. Experimental results show the new algorithm is more timely to the increasing trend of RTT when the network load is heavy that compared with Jacobson's algorithm.

articleTitle: Iterative Channel Estimation and Turbo Equalization Using ICI Cancellation for MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Turbo equalization algorithms have been used to effectively improve the performance in MIMO OFDM systems. To improve the estimated accuracies of channel matrix, an iterative estimation using soft decided signals and pilots was proposed. Furthermore, a new iterative equalization method based on subtracting interference terms, it is a maximum a posterior probability (MAP) MMSE algorithm and has lower complexity than traditional algorithms. Simulation results indicate that the proposed methods can yield remarkable improvements in performance after no less than two iterations.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Comparison of Mobile Instant Messaging Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of Mobile Internet, Instant Messaging (IM) applications begin to transplant from the PC to the mobile terminal, to bring in Mobile Instant Messaging (MIM). In this paper, on the basis of the different network technologies, the MIM frameworks have been divided into three categories - telecom based, web based and wIMS2.0 based MIM. To investigate and further optimize the performance of those three MIM systems, we analyze and compare the three different MIM frameworks in terms of signaling overhead, protocol overhead, the format of data exchange, traffic of the mobile devices and response delay. After the analysis of the results, telecom based MIM turns out to have the minimum response delay, and the real-time property of this system is also good; web based MIM has the smallest traffic overhead and system resource overhead; wIMS2.0 based MIM has Restful interfaces and diverse encoding formats, and is easy to develop with good scalability. In the end, we propose a telecom&wIMS2.0 based MIM framework, which is more instantaneous than web based one, and easier to develop than telecom based one.

articleTitle: A P2P Flow Identification Model Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The fundamental work of managing P2P flow is to identify various P2P flows. In this essay, we constitute a uniform P2P flow identification model-UFIM, and analyze different identification methods. An idea to describe UFIM abstractly utilizing Bayesian network model is advanced. We make 6 measurements to denote identification performance. The contrasting result in theory analysis and experiments shows that UFIM can denote various type of P2P flow identification method abstractly. All these works establish the base of giving new identification method further.

articleTitle: Subcarrier Allocating Algorithm in MB-OFDM UWB System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the subcarrier allocation for multi-user in multi-band orthogonal frequency division multiplexing ultra-wideband (MB-OFDM UWB) system. A novel allocating algorithm is proposed to minimize the total transmission power subjective to a given bit error rate (BER) and user's data rate. The algorithm is divided into three parts, cluster selection, the bit allocation and adjustment of cluster-allocation results. The clustering scheme is used to reduce the complexity of the algorithm. Simulation results show that the algorithm has more than 1 dB gain over other algorithms in power per bit and bit error rate.

articleTitle: Sinusoidal Modulation Gaussian Pulse Used in UWB SATCOM
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The possibility of satellite communication systems using UWB signals is considered recently. UWB schemes are proposed in IEEE 802.15 TG3a and terrestrial short-range high-speed communications have been mature. In this paper, the possibility of UWB satellite communication(SATCOM) systems using cognitive radio(CR) is considered and a kind of sinusoidal modulation Gaussian pulse used for UWB SATCOM is put forward. The initial results show that sinusoidal modulation Gaussian pulse has flexibable spectrum configuration and it is suitable for CR wireless radio. Therefor UWB SATCOM towards CR has broad application prospect.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of AFH_OFDM System Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: OFDM (Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) is the key technology to 4G in the field of mobile communication. The theory of FH_OFDM and AFH_OFDM (Adaptive frequency hopping-Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) systems is introduced firstly in this article, and the Simulink toolbox is used to set up the simulation model for AFH_OFDM system. In this paper, we compare the BER performance of FH_OFDM and OFDM systems in multi-path Rayleigh fading channel, and also compare the BER performance of AFH_OFDM system and FH_OFDM system in the condition of the broadband uniform noise and the bandlimited uniform noise. The simulation result shows that FH_OFDM system has a better BER performance than OFDM system in the condition of different interferences, and the BER performance of AFH_OFDM is better than FH_OFDM in the condition of the uniform noise.

articleTitle: Enhanced Network Coding for TCP in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the TCP performance in wireless networks, J.K.Sundararajan et al proposed a new protocol based on network coding which is called TCP/NC in [1,2]. But the asynchronism in data transmission and decoding operation which may seriously affect the TCP/NC performance was not considered. To address this issue, a revised protocol TCP/NCW is proposed in this paper. In our scheme, the coding window is adjusted according to the decoding time and will finally reach an optimal window size. This scheme can ensure the synchronization of data transfer and decoding operation, resulting in better performance. Simulation results with NS-2 show that TCP/NCW achieves significant improvement in throughput compared to both TCP-Vegas and TCP/NC in lossy wireless networks.

articleTitle: The Performance of Cooperative Distributed Space Time Block Codes (CDSTBC) in Wireless System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile communication companies at present are looking for a 4G technology that aims at better reliability. This aim can be achieved by using Multiple Inputs Multiple Outputs (MIMO) system which is difficult to implement for the mobile terminals due to the limitations of the complexity, size and cost. So, these companies have been looking for a system which emulates a MIMO system. The cooperative relaying system has been proposed as a solution to be used to take the advantages of MIMO. The cooperative relaying system enables single antenna mobiles in a multi user environment to share their antennas and generate a virtual multiple antenna transmitters. In this paper, we investigate a single relay system that aims for a reliable communication. The main goal of this paper is to study the feasibility of the proposed single relay cooperative transmission in the mobile environment, and evaluate it with respect to the direct link transmission. Both systems are presented and a comparison in terms of bit error rate (BER) reveals that the single relay system performs better. The proposed single relay system needs an efficient coding technique to improve the performance in terms of reliability. Therefore, STBC as a coding technique is used, and the results proved that this technique decreases the BER.

articleTitle: Information Transmission on Complex Field Network Coding for Single-Source Multi-Destination Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For International Mobile Telecommunications (IMT)-Advanced standards, relay has been included in radio cell to improve the transmission efficiency and throughput of wireless networks. In this paper, for the downlink transmission of IMT-Advanced cellular networks, an efficient information transmission scheme based on complex field network coding is proposed. Specifically, different from complex field network coding that encodes the symbols from multiple sources, the scheme expands the encoding from space dimension to time dimension, and encodes the symbols of multiple time slots from the unique base station. Theoretic analysis and simulation results demonstrate that, compared with conventional relay forwarding scheme, the scheme can achieve higher network throughput. Moreover, we further investigate the symbol error probability (SEP) performance, and evaluate SEPs of the proposed scheme in various scenarios for different SNR values

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Dual-Amplitude Pulse Position Modulation for Optical Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced the work principle of dual-amplitude pulse position modulation, analyzed the transmission efficiency, channel capacity, power spectral density, and compared with the other modulation schemes as OOK, PPM, DPIM, DAPIM analyzed the bandwidth, information rate of unit and transmission capacity. Simulation show that DAPPM has better bandwidth efficiency than DPIM and PPM, DAPPM is more suitable transmission in the communication environment and the channel of encoded.

articleTitle: Research of Relationship of Wireless Energy Efficiency and Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, Green communication technology is one of the most promising technologies of next wireless generation network. It plays an important role in saving energy, reducing network operation costs and protecting environment. In this paper, the energy consumption of different component in a wireless network is collected. The relationship between the energy efficiency and spectrum in the typical wireless network is analyzed and modeled based on LTE system. Simulation results verify the energy efficiency-spectrum tradeoffs in cellular networks with single cell, multi-cell and co-channel interference.

articleTitle: Double Latch Pre-Charge Sense Amplifier in Non-Volatile Memory for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A newly proposed Double Latch Pre-charge Sense Amplifier (DLPSA) is introduced in the embedded non- volatile memory design for the wireless application, especially for smart cards with wireless & contactless feature, e.g., bank cards (wireless credit cards). This DLPSA has been implemented in both SMIC 0.18im and 0.13im process of ROM IPs. Comparing with the conventional sense amplifier, DLPSA has lower current consumption, lower minimum voltage and wider voltage range. This novel sense amplifier/driver structure is capable of restoring the full signal swing effectively. On top of that, its minimum VDD equates to low power consumption at VDD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MIN</sub>.

articleTitle: A Design of Multi-Frequency High-Frequency Radar Receiver System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For high-frequency radar, ship targets detection is seriously affected by the strong sea clutter. To solve the problem, a design of multi-frequency radar receiver system is presented, which completes digital mixer and digital down converter for multi- channel digital receivers based on FPGA and carries out system controls and data transmission by USB2.0 interface. The system closed-loop test shows that the scheme can work in multi-frequency mode which meets the requirements of HF radar application.

articleTitle: Access Network Selection Scheme for beyond 3G System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the beyond 3G system with multiple heterogeneous RATs, the Radio Resource Management (RRM) considering multiple access network is most important for the service provisions. To guarantee the good user experience, the network selection should consider the QoS requirements of traffics and different access networks' situations to give the best choice for the users. Based on the proposed handover procedure, the Analytic Hierarchy Process based network selection algorithm (AONA) is proposed in this paper, which uses a scientific method to analyze the optimization network considering the practical scenarios.

articleTitle: A Novel Metric for Measuring Multiple Antennas System Capacity over Energy Consumption Requirements
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the capacity to the total energy consumption per bit ratio of multiple antennas systems. The wireless communication system is assumed to operate in indoor propagation environment. A scattering model of wireless communication channel is presented. The channel model considers both the line of sight (LOS) and the NLOS (non line of sight) components. Computer simulations are carried out for the capacity to the total energy consumption ratio by varying both the distance separation between the transmitter and the receiver and the number of transmit antennas. We show in this paper, that the gain in capacity increases with the number of antennas but it is still limited by the total energy consumption. As such, we find by simulations the limits for increasing the number of transmit antennas. This could be determined by a new metric which is the "capacity to energy ratio".

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Optimization of Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Based on Soft Combination
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The performance of cooperative spectrum sensing was analyzed based on soft combination of data fusion and decision fusion under both imperfect sensing channels and reporting channels in cognitive radio networks, and the closed expression of detection and false alarm probability also given. The optimal soft combination algorithm for maximizing the detection probability was proposed for further, in which the modified deflection coefficient used to obtain the optimal weighting vector based on the NP criticism. The simulation results indicate that the detection performance could be effectively improved by the optimal algorithm. Compared with data fusion, only a little detection performance loss exists in decision fusion.

articleTitle: Outage Probability of Two Hop Relaying with Interference at Both the Relay and the Destination
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the outage probability performance of interference-limited wireless relay networks is investigated. The considered wireless relay networks consist of several cooperation units (CUs, defined as one source and destination node pair with a relay node associated to it). All source nodes transmit their own signals simultaneously and the relay node in each CU then forwards the received signal to the destination node, causing co-channel interference at both the relay node and the destination node in each CU. The outage probability of the link between the source node and the destination node in a CU over Rayleigh slow-fading channels with interference is analyzed for the decode-and-forward (DF) relaying strategy. The end-to-end outage probability in a CU and the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) distribution are derived in closed form. Numerical results indicate the effect of interference.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Testing of a FPGA Based PTP System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 1588 specifies the precision time protocol (PTP) to synchronize independent locks with high synchronization accuracy. In this paper, PTP is implemented based on embedded FPGA board with hardware based timestamp and the performances of system setup for wire and wireless network are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: The Novel Frame Boundary Detection and Fast Frame Synchronous Structure for 10 Gb/s Ethernet Phy FEC Sub-Layer VLSI Implementation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents the 10 Gb/s Ethernet Phy Forward Error Correction (FEC) sub-layer novel VLSI structure with the following 2 ideas: one is the frame boundary detecting methodology and the other is the fast frame synchronous structure. The first method increases the frame synchronizing speed by fully optimizing the candidate start position shift algorithm to accelerate the frame synchronization process; and the second structure increases the frame synchronizing speed by fully optimizing the structure of FEC decoder in the receiver to accelerate the frame synchronization process. The methods are used in a kind of network device to realize the FEC functions, and experimental result shows that the frame synchronizing speed is twice that of the conventional method, while the hardware overhead is very small.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Scalable Implementation of Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem on NIST Prime Field
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the importance of information security and the difference between symmetric cryptography unsymmetric cryptography are introduced. Then the principles of Elliptic Curve Cryptography and the advantages of the prime fields in FIPS 186-2 are discussed. Based on these, the flexible architecture of Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem is proposed and the implementation is described. In the end, a conclusion is drawn that the prime fields have many advantages over the orther prime fields.

articleTitle: A Study of Spectrum Sensing Algorithm for Ultra High Speed WLAN
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For a higher transmission rate and a greater throughput, New Generation Ultra High Speed WLAN must introduce Cognitive Radio (CR) technology to enhance frequency spectrum utilization. To detect the channel, this paper using two spectrum sensing algorithms, energy detection and preamble detection. The former utilizes the energy in signal to detect; the latter utilizes some features of the signal in the channel to detect. This paper then tests and verifies the two algorithms, and the model uses the 8X8 MIMO-OFDM system and high order modulation, so they can be used for detecting channel in Ultra High Speed WLAN environment. From the result, this two algorithms are feasible.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Uplink IFDMA in the Presence of Carrier Frequency Offsets
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In uplink of interleaved single carrier frequency division multiple access (SC-FDMA) systems, multiple access interference (MAI) arises from different carrier frequency offsets (CFOs) from different users at the receiver. In this paper, the performance of uplink interleaved FDMA (IFDMA) in the presence of CFOs is exactly analyzed. An expression of signal to interference plus noise power ratio (SINR) is derived for the IFDMA systems in the presence of CFOs. Furthermore, an approximate average bit error ratio (BER) expression is also derived as function of the SINR, where the moment generating function is used to derive cumulative density function of SINR, under the scenario of Rayleigh fading channels. Finally, both analytical and simulated BER results are given to verify the derived results.

articleTitle: Random Linear Network Coding with Cooperating in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the throughput and transmission reliability in wireless sensor network with limited resources, multicast network coding technology is imported in. On this basis, through random linear network coding by nodes' cooperation to make improvement in delayed and expense. The simulation results show that the transmission, to the opportunity routing, by cooperation network coding strategies is improved in making full use of space-time reusability, reducing the delay and enhancing the throughput and transmission reliability of wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Distributed Asynchronous Reservation Multichannel MAC Protocol for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperation among wireless nodes has been extensively studied in literals mainly used as data relaying mechanisms, however, it has been less exploited from control plane perspective to prevent undesirable transmission consequences such as data collisions.In this work, we investigate control plane cooperation in multichannel wireless ad hoc networks and propose a multichannel MAC protocol named by Distributed Asynchronous Reservation MAC(DARMAC). In DARMAC, nodes shares their information about network space in a dedicated control channel and cooperatively selects a collision free channel for the node that wants to transmit. Simulations are conducted for both single and multihop network with IEEE 802.11g/a parameter set, the results are compared with the recently proposed cooperative asynchronous multichannel MAC (CAMMAC). On average, the DARMAC has a performance gain over CAMMAC around 10-20%.

articleTitle: Locating the Optimal Sleep Window for Enhancing the Energy Efficiency of VoIP in WiMAX Systems: A Modified Analysis Model and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we examine the energy-performance tradeoff for the sleep window adjustment in duplex VoIP transmissions. Specifically, we modified the traditional analysis model by giving a new mathematical model to analyze the performance of the sleep scheme, with the natural talking speed, sleep window size, energy expenditure taken into consideration. Guided by this model, we locate the optimal window adjustment parameters for the sleep scheme. Extensive simulation results have validated the analytical model, and indicated that, compared with the traditional scheme, the optimized scheme can achieve as much as 90% reduction in energy dissipation during silence period and prolong battery lifetime for about 20-30%, thus striking a balance between energy conservation and QoS provision.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing Based on Signal Sample Autocorrelation in Rayleigh Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Spectrum Sensing is the first challenge of Cognitive Radio. The signal detection of primary users (PU) is a basic premise of spectrum sensing. In this paper, we adopt a method based on the sample autocorrelation of received signal to detect the existence of primary users' signals. It is called Sample Autocorrelation Matrix (SAM) method. Simulation results by using the randomly the captured digital television (DTV) signals show that the method outperforms the traditional energy detection method in detection performance. Due to the PU signals can be detected without the knowledge of the noise power under Rayleigh Fading channel environment, SAM method is robust to the noise uncertainty and the fading channel.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Queues with Batch Poisson Arrival and GE Service
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyses the queueing systems with batch Poisson arrivals and Generalised exponential (GE)service and gives closed form expressions for performance distributions, such as steady state queue length distribution (q.l.d.), blocking probability and waiting time distribution. The analytical performance expressions provide network engineers and researchers a tool to analysis the queues with batch Poisson arrival process and GE service.

articleTitle: High-Performance Deblocking Filter Design and Implementation for AVS HDTV Application
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A high-performance deblocking filter for AVS HDTV application is proposed in this paper. Optimized filtering order and effective filtering process are applied to improve the system efficiency. Parallel processing of filtering operations, data reading, caching, transposing and writing is realized, which facilitates filtering operation while reducing temporary data storage. With data caching/transposing module, the data reuse strategy in vertical and horizontal filtering is implemented. Further, pipeline structure is adopted in filter operation module to improve the working frequency. The simulation shows that it requires 168 clock cycles to filter one macro block (MB). When the working frequency is 100 MHz, this deblocking filter is capable of deblocking with 1080HD (1920×1088, 72fps).

articleTitle: Power Allocation of Multi-Users Based on Optimal Power Allocation Algorithm in Uplink Base Stations Cooperative System
publicationTitle: 2011 7th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In cellular systems with tight frequency reuse, one base station receives signals not only from users in local cell but also from users in adjacent cell, which cause co-channel interference. In this paper, we achieve a base stations cooperative system based on a successive interference cancellation method and a power allocation algorithm with low backhaul traffic. It requires users detected in local base station with an order. One base station detects local users firstly, then it passes on the information to the other base stations so that the other base stations detect local users. Since quantized reliability information is transferred system enable better detection of the received data streams and required lower backhaul traffic. The total backhaul traffic is always less than joint detection for a few base stations in cooperation. The proposed power allocation strategies are to be used together with the cooperative system to achieve some required performance regardless scenario and location of users.
